At a young age, I learned a hard lesson about surviving in a Communist regime: conform and keep your thoughts private. Do not trust anyone, even your friends.

Everything changed when an American exchange student showed me a pocket-sized version of "The Declaration of Independence." In 1988, I made it to America with only $100 in my pocket, which I borrowed, along with a $1,200 loan from my sponsor. I spoke very little English. _And here's where the death threats from Beijing started: when I decided to run for Congress._

The Democrats don't want my story to reach the ears of my fellow Americans because they hope to enact their Socialist Agenda.

But more importantly, you and I cannot afford to let the woke liberal elite plunge the America we know and love any further down the dark path of Communism and trample on our God-given rights.

Fellow American,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

**Well, Fellow American, I took those same ideals I learned as a Waffle House waitress to Congress. I refuse to waiver to what anyone wants other than the constituents I was elected by,_even if it means pissing off some party members along the way._**

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
In case you missed it in our Sunday News Digest, make sure you check out this week's **[new episode](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** of Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl where I interview Vanessa Rutledge from [Citizens for a Safe and Clean Denver](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and take a behind-the-scenes tour of the [Springs Rescue Mission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, May 22, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Caldara: Looming gas price hike entirely Jared Polis' doing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Governor Jared Polis' decision to [rescind a waiver from the EPA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for reformulated gas has led to an anticipated spike of $0.50 to $1 per gallon in gas prices, despite Colorado's limited responsibility for ozone pollution.
* While former Governor John Hickenlooper previously requested a waiver from the EPA to prevent this price increase, Polis' decision to rescind this request has been criticized as [political malfeasance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* Despite the economic and environmental consequences of his decision, Polis has attempted to portray himself as [fighting against the EPA's requirements](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after realizing the fallout from his actions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[El Paso, Teller counties to get $66 million in grants to address opioid epidemic](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* El Paso and Teller counties are set to receive [$66 million through 2038](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to address the opioid epidemic. The regional council, comprising 15 officials, has awarded the first round of funding, allocating about $3.8 million, with $1.1 million reserved for additional [youth prevention programs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The funding will [support various initiatives](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including youth and community prevention, medication-assisted treatment, family advocates for those affected by overdose, and recovery support like sober living homes.
* The funding aims to address the [opioid epidemic](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that has claimed hundreds of lives in the region, with a focus on effective support and treatment, youth prevention, and family advocacy programs.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Walcher: The importance of Jim Evans in the battle for PILT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY GREG WALCHER, [RMV COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I did a double-take when I saw the headline: "Meeker County to call on Congress to pay up for federal lands."_
_I thought it must be a typo, because Meeker is a town and not a county (it 's in Rio Blanco County). The subtitle repeated it: "Analysis of public lands in Meeker County found that federal revenues fall short of what property taxes would generate." _
_I wondered what reporter made such an error, but then noticed it was from the West Central Minnesota Tribune, an area where there is in fact a "Meeker County," an entirely different place named for an entirely different historical figure. But the headline certainly makes clear that the two communities have something in common. South Central Minnesota and Western Colorado are both largely rural, contain federal lands, and do not get their fair share of Payments in Lieu of Taxes (PILT). _
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado's (not yet signed) new law bans cellphone use while driving. When can it lead to a traffic stop?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's new law [banning cellphone use while driving](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) will go into effect on Jan. 1, 2025. Drivers can be pulled over for using a cellphone if law enforcement sees them doing so in a manner that causes careless or imprudent driving, with the phone visible in the hand or against the ear.
* [Exceptions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) include emergency situations, calling first responders, navigation, and using dictation or transcription functions.
* Penalties for violating the law include a [$75 fine and two points against the license](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the first offense within two years, with increasing fines and points for subsequent offenses.
* [Seizure of phones is not allowed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as part of an investigation or citation for cellphone use while driving, and existing laws already prohibit texting or browsing while driving, with specific restrictions for drivers under 18.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[The next grey wolf? Gov. Polis signs bill to reintroduce wolverines in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Governor Jared Polis [signed several bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) during his visit across the Western Slope, covering issues like highway safety, wildfire mitigation, and species conservation.
* One of the significant bills signed is the [reintroduction of wolverines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to Colorado, with the state's wildlife division tasked to bring 45 wolverines over three years.
* Other bills signed include [House Bill 1135](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which increases penalties for operating commercial motor vehicles without proper licenses, and [Senate Bill 100](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which extends the Colorado Department of Transportation's authority for highway closures and specific equipment requirements.
* Polis also signed bills related to wildfire mitigation, including [House Bills 1006](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [1024](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which create a rural grant navigator program and enhance wildfire awareness month outreach campaigns, respectively.
* Additionally, bills related to sports betting tax revenue, conservation easement laws, and facilitating the reintroduction of wolverines were also signed by Governor Polis during his visit.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**THE NEWEST EPISODE OF UNLEASHED 🎙️**
|
---
**[Episode 26: Meeting Homelessness with Hope](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** FEATURING VANESSA RUTLEDGE AND SPRINGS RESCUE MISSION
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
This week's episode confronts Denver's worsening homelessness crisis, highlighting a $274 million investment from 2021 to 2024 that has failed to yield significant improvements, prompting discussions on accountability and viable solutions, including examining the "homeless industrial complex" and the systemic failures of major service providers, while advocating for transparency, strategic overhaul, and community engagement to address the entrenched challenges effectively.
__
**[LISTEN OR WATCH THE FULL EPISODE HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**

__
**[Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl: Meeting Homelessness with Hope](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | MAY 19** _Despite a staggering $274 million investment from 2021 to 2024, the situation has only deteriorated, sparking outrage and demanding accountability. _
**[Only 3 state legislators get'A' grade on '24 Liberty Scorecard, 87% of legislators fail the test](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | MAY 15** _Three percent of all state legislators graded an A and 87% of legislators had a failing grade in the Liberty Scorecard Colorado ratings released Friday following the close of the 74th General Assembly._

**🌪 ️ DID YOU KNOW?** The **most destructive tornado** that has ever happened in Colorado occurred on **May 22, 2008** , when an EF3 tornado ripped through 24 miles of western Weld County for more than 30 minutes.

This tornado tore through the town of Windsor and caused an estimated $147 million in damages. According to the [Coloradoan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), one person was killed and 78 people were injured in the storm.

body:
Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it. | [ ](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=89ecd156ef644a949018b42305c8918a&_e=6jBapCmNDJ4gA6duX4ocukIcVD5gnnqe3CeTIlMxBHlnscolp3vXLrsmt2dtGKZxkmBoeXZLALeQB60_8ddivIda50xiHNwAq0Jow3JAt5cbltMr6CBDkJChABJx-U99SVDKkdHtQX6kpPCnMFuMbWzJdRC06896nMT_CG14AkvR_7fCHZrJQrqFwhKQvmbAG7zEZX4_K9tCOGovnUICyu8zenSrRKv8-kS6Moq9_p8p7R7v5YoExau1vaDakV9t8LY8u85VevBVaQU2da96fDkzmXs70sBeK6JMzvIV_cvg2N59saVl2UFBXLNFhyU4WfxIwaxIsIretBhv-rjzRiidXGfDJGoIV7yptPq9CNpfE3TeCKL_2_2EiR9bk1iI)
---
Fellow American,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

EXCLUSIVE: What You Need to Know Before the Illinois GOP Convention (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/what-you-need-to-know-before-the-illinois-gop-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ecdd7a3c97-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

By Thomas McCullagh, Publisher

The Illinois State Republican Convention is fast approaching, set to take place on Friday, May 24, and Saturday, May 25, at the Gateway Convention Center in Collinsville, IL. This event will gather Republicans from across the state for networking, socializing, training, and learning opportunities. However, beyond these activities, the convention holds significant importance as it offers delegates a unique opportunity to influence the direction of the party for the next four years. The main tasks will include adopting a new platform and electing Illinois representatives to the Republican National Committee (RNC).

Understanding the rules and mechanics of the convention is vital for those attending. The opportunity for grassroots participants and delegates to impact the party’s direction is scheduled for only 3.5 hours on Saturday afternoon. This brief window makes it essential for delegates to be well-versed in the rules. Without this knowledge, decisions about the platform and the selection of RNC members could be dominated by those who wrote the rules, rather than by the delegates themselves.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/what-you-need-to-know-before-the-illinois-gop-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ecdd7a3c97-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/what-you-need-to-know-before-the-illinois-gop-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ecdd7a3c97-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

The first order of business at the convention will be adopting the Rules of Order. These rules are crucial as they determine how officers are nominated and elected, how the platform is approved and adopted, and much more. Essentially, the adopted rules will decide who gets their voices heard and who has the power to influence key decisions.

For delegates who wish to challenge the proposed rules, the time to act is when the convention is called to order. According to the current bylaws of the Illinois Republican Party, specifically Articles VI and VII, the convention itself has the authority to set its own rules. This means that unless delegates propose and adopt alternate rules at the opening of the convention, the rules proposed by the Rules and Procedures committee will be enacted. These rules will then govern the adoption of the platform and the nomination and election of members to the RNC.

Per Article VII (H) of the bylaws, the proposed convention rules must be published on the Illinois Republican Party website and made available in printed form to each delegation chair forty-eight hours before the convention opens.

With the general business session starting at 11:30 AM on Saturday, the rules should be published by 11:30 AM on Thursday.

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Asking my GOP colleagues to prove that they’re not hypocrites…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends, earlier this month I delivered a speech on the House floor that asked my Republican House colleagues to prove to the American people that they’re not hypocrites.
Why? Let’s discuss.
184 of my GOP colleagues have cosponsored legislation that supports “fetal personhood” – aka giving embryos the same full legal rights as a person.
This is fringe ideology, and it’s incredibly dangerous. Not only could it be used to prosecute people for miscarriages or for having an abortion, it could potentially affect access to birth control – and it could definitely threaten access to IVF.
During IVF, doctors often create more fertilized embryos than they plan on using, because some may be genetically unviable or result in miscarriages.
I know this, because three years ago, during my first year in Congress, I froze my eggs – which means I went through the initial stages of IVF, except that after egg retrieval, my eggs were frozen and stored.
For weeks, I took hormone pills, gave myself injections, and went to the doctor for check-ups. Then, I had a procedure under twilight sedation to harvest my eggs.
I have 17 mature eggs frozen now. Patients like me pay for the storage of their eggs and embryos – and eventually, some embryos are usually donated for medical research or destroyed.
But fetal personhood legislation – and state court rulings like the one in Alabama – could force patients to pay for storage of their embryos forever or leave clinics liable to criminal charges if embryos are damaged. That’s why at least one IVF clinic in Alabama is ending the service – and this is just the beginning.
News flash for my Republican colleagues who claim they don’t want to do away with IVF: You can’t simultaneously support “fetal personhood” and support IVF access.
You can’t falsely claim to be “pro-life” and then rip away people’s dreams of having children.
And you can’t try to bury your true end goal – attacking reproductive care and controlling our bodies and lives.
So I called on all 184 House Republicans – including Speaker Johnson – who have cosponsored legislation that would treat embryos as children and threaten access to IVF to come to the House Floor and publicly remove their names from these bills.
Republicans, how about it? Prove that you really do support IVF access. Prove that you support families. Prove that you’re not a hypocrite.
I’m guessing they won’t take me up on it.
So while we wait for the GOP to grow a spine (which could take...forever), we’ve got to focus our energy on another path: Flipping the House and regaining our Democratic majority!
I’m doing every single thing I can to get it done – starting with delivering a resounding defeat to my anti-abortion MAGA opponent. Will you join me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Getting out the vote and showing up for our communities / Estamos sacando el voto y ayudando a nuestras comunidades
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Texas Primary Runoffs are underway.
Head to the polls.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Vote%20fist.png]
Building a more progressive, equitable, and inclusive Texas means electing into office people-powered champions who will help us win on the issues that affect our communities. These primary runoffs are an opportunity for us to assert our values, flex our progressive power, and have our voice heard on who we want fighting for us at the local, state, and federal level.
Early voting for the primary runoffs started Monday, May 20, and runs through Friday, May 24. Election Day is Tuesday, May 28.
VOTE for the following TOP-endorsed candidates who will be on the ballot in Bexar and Harris County:
• Rebeca Clay-Flores [https://rebecaclayflores.com/] for Bexar County Commissioner, Pct. 1
• Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] for State Senate, Dist. 15 (Harris County)
• Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] for State Representative, Dist. 146 (Harris County)
• Annette Ramirez [https://www.electannetteramirez.com/] for Tax Assessor-Collector (Harris County)
• Gemayel Haynes [http://www.haynesforjudge.com/] for 486th Dist. Court Judge (Harris County)
Stepping up to help Houstonians after devastating storms, and calling for climate change action
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20storm%20recovery%202024.jpg]
In the wake of last Thursday's devastating storms that tore through Houston leaving a million residents without power [https://fortune.com/2024/05/18/houston-storm-power-outages-1-million-death-toll-heat-flood-warning/] , TOP staff hit the streets with progressive allies including Workers Defense Project and Texas Gulf Coast AFL-CIO to assess the needs of Harris County residents in hard-hit neighborhoods and connect them with much-needed recovery resources.
The devastating impact of these Houston storms highlights the urgent need for comprehensive climate action and infrastructure reform. Climate change is not a distant threat; it’s here and now, and it’s hitting our communities the hardest. Black and Latino families across Houston are bearing the brunt of these extreme weather events, which are becoming more frequent and severe from climate change. These prolonged power outages turn the recovery period from a single storm into weeks and months.
TOP stands with all residents affected by these storms and calls on state and local leaders to prioritize policies that address climate change, strengthen our energy infrastructure, and look out for Texans most in need. We must move away from short-term fixes and invest in long-term solutions that ensure all Texans can weather storms ahead.
The way forward is clear: we must vote out Gov. Abbott and his far-right, MAGA extremists allies at the local and state levels. Our power lies at the ballot box, and Black and Latino Texans are determined to build the collective power necessary to create a future where ALL Texans can prosper — regardless of race, faith, gender, or background.
Condemning our governor for his dangerous and cruel pardon
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BLM%20Garrett.jpg]
This past Friday, Gov. Greg Abbott pardoned convicted murderer Daniel Perry [https://www.nbcdfw.com/news/local/texas-news/texas-governor-pardon-man-convicted-in-protestor-murder/3543281/] , simply because the murderer hates Black Lives Matter protesters just like him, plain and simple. This is how much disdain our governor has for everyday Texans who take a stand against the brutalization of Black Americans at the hands of law enforcement, and who voice their support for our collective liberation. This is how much he despises justice.
There is no low Gov. Abbott won’t stoop to in order to win over the growing white nationalist wing of today’s Republican Party. It should infuriate every Texan that we have in the Governor's Mansion an extremist who only serves as a mouthpiece for Trump, and who will twist our state's legal system to serve his far-right MAGA agenda.
As hard as Abbott may try, he will NOT silence our movement for change, nor will he keep the millions of Black and Latino Texans who proudly reside in this state from winning a future where ALL can live free and thrive.
We extend our deepest sympathies to the family and friends of Garrett Foster as they continue to grieve and process the loss of their loved one, especially after this appalling act from our governor.
TOP Tips: Hurricane season is almost here. Make sure you're stocked up.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hurricane.jpg]
With extreme weather continuing to escalate due to climate change, it's never a bad time to check you have some basic supplies handy in the case of severe weather. View a checklist of emergency kit items to have at home. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/graphics/2024/05/01/how-to-stay-safe-from-hurricanes-preparation-tips-and-disaster-plans/73515320007/]
Español
Las elecciones primarias de Texas ya están aquí. Es hora de votar.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Vote%20fist.png]
Construir un Texas más progresista, equitativo e inclusivo significa elegir a campeones defensores impulsados por el pueblo que nos ayudarán a ganar en los temas que afectan a nuestras comunidades. Estas elecciones primarias son una oportunidad para que hagamos valer nuestros valores, mostrar nuestro poder progresista y hagamos oír nuestra voz sobre quién queremos que luche por nosotros a nivel local, estatal y federal.
La votación anticipada para la segunda vuelta comenzó el lunes 20 de mayo y se extenderá hasta el viernes 24 de mayo. El día de las elecciones es el martes 28 de mayo.
VOTE por los siguientes candidatos respaldados por TOP que estarán en la boleta electoral en Bexar y el condado de Harris:
• Rebeca Clay-Flores [https://rebecaclayflores.com/] para el Comisionado del Condado de Bexar, Pct. 1
• Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] para el Senado Estatal, Dist. 15 (Condado de Harris)
• Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] para Representante Estatal, Dist. 146 (Condado de Harris)
• Annette Ramirez [https://www.electannetteramirez.com/] para Tasadora-Recaudadora de Impuestos (Condado de Harris)
• Gemayel Haynes [http://www.haynesforjudge.com/] para juez del Tribunal de Distrito 486 (Condado de Harris)
Ayudando a los habitantes de Houston después de tormentas devastadoras y pidiendo medidas contra el cambio climático
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20storm%20recovery%202024.jpg]
Con las devastadoras tormentas del jueves pasado que azotaron Houston y dejaron a un millón de residentes sin electricidad [https://fortune.com/2024/05/18/houston-storm-power-outages-1-million-death-toll-heat-flood-warning/] , el personal de TOP salió a las calles con aliados progresistas, incluido el Proyecto de Defensa de los Trabajadores y la AFL-CIO de la Costa del Golfo de Texas, para evaluar las necesidades de los residentes del condado de Harris en los vecindarios más afectados y conectarse. proporcionarles recursos de recuperación muy necesarios.
El impacto devastador de estas tormentas de Houston resalta la urgente necesidad de una acción climática integral y una reforma de la infraestructura. El cambio climático no es una amenaza lejana; está aquí y ahora, y está afectando más a nuestras comunidades. Las familias Negras y Latinas en todo Houston están sufriendo la peor parte de estos eventos climáticos extremos, que se están volviendo más frecuentes y severos debido al cambio climático. Estos cortes de energía prolongados hacen que el período de recuperación de una sola tormenta se convierta en semanas y meses.
TOP apoya a todos los residentes afectados por estas tormentas y pide a los líderes estatales y locales que prioricen las políticas que abordan el cambio climático, fortalecen nuestra infraestructura energética y velan por los tejanos más necesitados. Debemos alejarnos de las soluciones de corto plazo e invertir en soluciones de largo plazo que garanticen que todos los tejanos puedan capear las tormentas que se avecinan.
El camino a seguir es claro: debemos expulsar al gobernador Abbott y a sus aliados extremistas de extrema derecha, MAGA, tanto a nivel local como estatal. Nuestro poder reside en las urnas, y los texanos Negros y Latinos están decididos a construir el poder colectivo necesario para crear un futuro en el que TODOS los texanos puedan prosperar, independientemente de su raza, fe, género o origen.
Condenamos a nuestro gobernado por su peligroso y cruel perdón
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BLM%20Garrett.jpg]
El viernes pasado, el gobernador Greg Abbott indultó al asesino convicto Daniel Perry [https://www.nbcdfw.com/news/local/texas-news/texas-governor-pardon-man-convicted-in-protestor-murder/3543281/] , simplemente porque el asesino odia a los manifestantes de Black Lives Matter como él, simple y llanamente . Así de desdén siente nuestro gobernador por los tejanos comunes y corrientes que se oponen a la brutalización de los afroamericanos a manos de las fuerzas del orden y que expresan su apoyo a nuestra liberación colectiva. Así desprecia la justicia. No hay nada bajo al que el gobernador Abbott no se rebaje para ganarse al creciente ala nacionalista blanca del Partido Republicano actual. Debería enfurecer a todos los texanos que tengamos en la Mansión del Gobernador a un extremista que solo sirve como portavoz de Trump y que distorsionará el sistema legal de nuestro estado para servir a su agenda MAGA de extrema derecha. Por mucho que Abbott lo intente, NO silenciará nuestro movimiento por el cambio, ni impedirá que los millones de tejanos negros y latinos que residen orgullosamente en este estado ganen un futuro en el que TODOS puedan vivir libres y prosperar. Extendemos nuestro más sentido pésame a la familia y amigos de Garrett Foster mientras continúan lamentándose y procesando la pérdida de su ser querido, especialmente después de este acto atroz de nuestro gobernador.
Consejos de TOP: La temporada de huracanes se acerca. Asegúrate de tener suministros
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hurricane.jpg]
Dado que el clima extremo sigue aumentando debido al cambio climático, nunca es un mal momento para asegurarse que tiene algunos suministros básicos a mano en caso de mal tiempo. Vea una lista de verificación de artículos del kit de emergencia para tener en casa. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/graphics/2024/05/01/how-to-stay-safe-from-hurricanes-preparation-tips-and-disaster-plans/73515320007/]

This is how much disdain our governor has for everyday Texans who take a stand against the brutalization of Black Americans at the hands of law enforcement, and who voice their support for our collective liberation. This is how much he despises justice. There is no low Gov. Abbott won’t stoop to in order to win over the growing white nationalist wing of today’s Republican Party. It should infuriate every Texan that we have in the Governor's Mansion an extremist who only serves as a mouthpiece for Trump, and who will twist our state's legal system to serve his far-right MAGA agenda. As hard as Abbott may try, he will NOT silence our movement for change, nor will he keep the millions of Black and Latino Texans who proudly reside in this state from winning a future where ALL can live free and thrive. We extend our deepest sympathies to the family and friends of Garrett Foster as they continue to grieve and process the loss of their loved one, especially after this appalling act from our governor. Estas elecciones primarias son una oportunidad para que hagamos valer nuestros valores, mostrar nuestro poder progresista y hagamos oír nuestra voz sobre quién queremos que luche por nosotros a nivel local, estatal y federal. ## Judge Blocks Sale of Graceland
A Memphis judge stopped the foreclosure sale of [Elvis Presley's iconic Graceland](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnsTcifGAgA0OXbOna0brA2aY9BwtfUuXtq3bu_C-_vo_rdMXC5b6840ZR5jphkvKkaVRgFNjJ9jnORECmpzj4wVnnR4B-jQjZplswZgwmeXMmQjek4LwbPCBSXyJosHoEo8PotD3Bzcy3cE7eJ61zyJ3VlIvUdvqs5S4rzfyqT2qnVLee4yqyH5156-DSwWWnujP9pg4uS8NEjPesDmRSK7JQVjgLNdUK00t9UX0sqzoYt42ymmujxPV4NFIoQtsuKrgRBm_7FvP-XZjL4Xxn9bJh4b8F-R_kGeEnAAD__3GUZHI) estate Wednesday, days after his granddaughter Riley Keough filed a lawsuit saying a company forged documents to force the sale. Keough's lawsuit claimed Naussany Investments and Private Lending LLC fabricated documents and signatures [to make it appear](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb0T4gW0YGLqwpWtHi8DDISJgAXaUv6_SuduVrnR0dH6u69XGFPP2bZ-oeyirdT2euE4UOAWxisHrgAjIB9TjMs5iXiaA4a4tk9xKDqPwiqtxdrNVkiku0SoV1DxEDQwEm4AzOc1MXODGw00qtyyOMS89EQx97KVeHiXmfseQ3uXEenHlOSR9731vhH8RMARMfu-l9c9FwHzABAybPhsImKPRjK9GwDwOvyEt1WNtdLdHQ1oyDaWiS6UdFWmzCWkJFNMZG90rtoTvRqMrOTq6Vesw2ewJmKFqv79iSrHNCxFse9qY_uz6_61ODb8BAAD__6c9a48) that her deceased mother, Lisa Marie Presley, took out a $3.8 million loan and used Graceland as collateral in 2018. Keough also submitted evidence that her mother never borrowed any money from Nassauny, with a notary public agreeing that they had never notarized anything Lisa Marie had supposedly signed. The judge called Graceland a [unique piece of real estate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuuozAUheGngc7IbN9I4WIaukw7JfJlY5xxTGQbUN5-lGjK0_3S1yytP_flbmKKOfw2T9Rt3RfjWjxxEQQYAb7w3usVEZD1qEc1Si6VAOg37Zn13Fg2rooJPlnOJbUSUEjlrbhBHzVQ4FQAo5OQlA9g2Wqnm1PKUeon33GKPra9DI895rbhmt77iWVw-7NPemvtVTv2q4O5g_m6riFbl_GqH-9g_mQH81HJ_3ocPiDxmMy7klCMw2SyJ9UkJPUIAWurBNMZv5q9N0fYGhZSYsI3-Yv7ETZSXDajYFxBX7R_XTGlWKXqOA1PE9N3XPv5qlPDvwAAAP__Lkxt5w) and ruled the property should remain with the Presley family until the validity of the documents could be verified.
## Daily Pot Use Surpasses Daily Drinking
For the first time, the number of Americans who report using marijuana daily [surpasses the number of people](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8jAQAJ8m6Yyc9V9SuPgaOr72ymhtb8hyjo0SA-LtT1x95Wia0Xxd5gty5nL9jxv5ttQZY-MnzUaAEqBn3Se_EAGpnvzgBqutMwD96pULEJVzEpMDNUHQYRq00lI6MMZCzx4kaGlAydFYqU8Q1BLGKToXpUxj6rSkxK3up1vl0lZa8rs-aT_FuvXZr63dj0796-DcwRnvhV7HR31gbxwzdXDecOfbAwuKiKVg4ENgjnWtWaSdyzeXq0jI-S0eB4kwDRGimYxbUoCkR7J2sFEFxEHHQfW7T_cX58yHdZ2W1w05_-a0v-c8PfwEAAD__5CmZVE) who say they have a drink every day. An analysis of national survey data shows that in 2022, nearly 18 million people reported using cannabis daily or near-daily, compared to 14.7 million daily or near-daily drinkers. In 1992, less than 1 million people said they used marijuana daily. Overall, far more people drink alcohol than use cannabis, but [40% of current pot users say they're using it 15-16 days](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8Gb0TkAOMMDF28pWtH64zP4VIMESap_PdVq46d35Oe9D6u0xU5cb6940a-rWXC0PhFk5WgJZjJdItfiYB0R_7szr3pnQXooreztmAphHMwc0AT1gGHwQ6kjbFEpmMPCoyyoNVge2VOMOt1Hi7BuaDUMizCKFq4lXq6F84t0pqO8qJ6CmXrko-tPXah3wSMAsYWKXJKP0zA-CiJwyFgjISpxYCVBIymdxftnFyQ0yE3rHx_Ykb53ElupZIMZdtKli1i_pOWyvmT801ixnTsvAsYu-qXxxenxHvvhFG3Dfk33LX_F708fAcAAP__rMBqiA) a month, while the median drinker reported drinking only four or five days a month.
## Illinois Eyes Renaming Convicts
Illinois lawmakers passed legislation to change the word _" offender" _to _"[justice-impacted individual](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L3unDAQBPCnMZ2Rb7ENFC7S0F3alMgfa9iTwSfY45S3j0j9b2ekn0bz5zk_PRXal99-Q8e5zj4yXTgbCZ0EPesmuYwI2DXoHv3DatsbgGZ11uYBtA8h6GjG0RudjQl9eNhhVL3tGnKgQCsDnRqMVbqF0OUwjLHvo1JpSEIrTMT1aF-Vdl4xl7_1wqONdWuKW5nfp-h-CZgETPEb4krRL_WuBUw3LmBSRsBEpdBe6ZQnsuQq4-r3BWXNGfeExx29PidTREnb20fGJGlPdFH6-CJplyd7Rln892xX3kpzuPT-3uxpe6HVsnkq_3fxzy9dDv4FAAD__x0QaxQ)"_ Tuesday in a move Republicans describe as disrespectful to victims of violent crime. House Bill 4409, which passed both houses, is part of a move to help parole-eligible prisoner find alternatives to jail. The new terminology is meant to reduce the stigma of being an "offender." Republicans claim the Democrat-authored bill removes accountability for people who commit crimes and creates a system that helps the criminal rather than crime victims. The bill would [change state documents](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPtCAUAH8Ndhh4gGJB8TV2-7VXGoTH-i4oGyWS_feXvfrqyWSS-XosD0-Zjud_v6OrqSw-VLpxMRwUB73oLrqECKg6dHKUgx5GA9BtTk9GSrUKs6YxrKhsTBAmqdY0-ClI35EDAVoYUMKaQegeVpVWO4VxDEJEG5kWGKmWs_8udNQNU36XG88-lL3Lbqv1dTH1j8HMYG6t9W-_lfKhDOYD28VgppzpKHTxV8lUKZA_Lu5p52HzxxN5K2fk0kirrbBDv9U9d6eLr_YRr2FkWjx3T_m3Wf8-cDv4CQAA__-GZF5F) to reflect the new "justice-impacted individual" term in place of "offender. It's been sent to Gov. J. B. Pritzker for his signature.

I'm running against Elise Stefanik. Can you help me beat Elise?
Just imagine if Elise Stefanik lost her seat in Congress.
It isn't impossible. But I need your help. Read on to see how I plan to win this race.
**Print media** : I have a fantastic digital team that sends texts and email to voters all over the country. But the voters of NY-21 are the people who will determine our success or failure, and many of them don't have reliable broadband. Ideally I'd like to have 6 postcards in every NY-21 voter's mailbox between now and November. That's around $2 million, bare bones minimum.
**Canvassers:** NY-21 is 14 counties, and over 15,000 square miles. Many people in the district haven't seen a candidate in decades. It isn't inconceivable that we could knock on every door in the district. But I need a core staff to manage a team of volunteers in each of the 14 counties that stretch across 15,000 square miles. With another $750,000-$900,000, we can reach that goal.
**Television, radio, and large billboard ads** would be icing on the cake. NY's 21st congressional district hits four media markets. That means the cost is four times as much to reach the same 779,000 that might be in only a few zip codes in other congressional districts. TV, radio, and billboards will be nice, but that expense is not in the budget unless I can find donations to foot the bill.
The last presidential cycle, Stefanik got 188,655, while her Democratic opponent Tedra Cobb got 131,995. In 2022, the margins were similarly proportioned. With comparable voter turnout, my win number is 161,000.
**Let that sink in: 161,000 voters can sink Stefanik.** And really, that's just 30,000 more voters than the Democratic candidate got in the last presidential cycle.
This race is tough, but it is not unwinnable. And can you imagine the psychological blow to the GOP if we were to un-seat Stefanik?
Can I count on you to help? [www.paulacollinsforcongress.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7f7a0ede-feae-406a-a765-774f063a6355?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (Donation button is there.)
Together we can do this,
Paula Collins

Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

clean_body: Please share this with everyone in your network | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more NY-21 Updates on the Congressional Race Please share this with everyone in your network | | | May 23 | | | | | | | | | | | | I'm running against Elise Stefanik. Can you help me beat Elise? Just imagine if Elise Stefanik lost her seat in Congress. It isn't impossible. But I need your help. Read on to see how I plan to win this race. Print media : I have a fantastic digital team that sends texts and email to voters all over the country. But the voters of NY-21 are the people who will determine our success or failure, and many of them don't have reliable broadband. Ideally I'd like to have 6 postcards in every NY-21 voter's mailbox between now and November. That's around $2 million, bare bones minimum. Canvassers: NY-21 is 14 counties, and over 15,000 square miles. Many people in the district haven't seen a candidate in decades. It isn't inconceivable that we could knock on every door in the district. But I need a core staff to manage a team of volunteers in each of the 14 counties that stretch across 15,000 square miles. With another $750,000-$900,000, we can reach that goal. Television, radio, and large billboard ads would be icing on the cake. NY's 21st congressional district hits four media markets. That means the cost is four times as much to reach the same 779,000 that might be in only a few zip codes in other congressional districts. TV, radio, and billboards will be nice, but that expense is not in the budget unless I can find donations to foot the bill. The last presidential cycle, Stefanik got 188,655, while her Democratic opponent Tedra Cobb got 131,995. In 2022, the margins were similarly proportioned. With comparable voter turnout, my win number is 161,000. Let that sink in: 161,000 voters can sink Stefanik.** And really, that's just 30,000 more voters than the Democratic candidate got in the last presidential cycle. This race is tough, but it is not unwinnable. And can you imagine the psychological blow to the GOP if we were to un-seat Stefanik? Can I count on you to help? (Donation button is there.) Together we can do this, Paula Collins If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=54f3fe9a8d234d33a8c272c5429d27c1&_e=sv-BZWCAYJ-dU6nl-89WoyZSPWIMBhIDfmfqkT9Y7M-a3JFlPW1AYg8eSvDjMkWbWrrmLKCVAVDpzioGjPDTpWY8HqKxEXFlodT7Y7wM5fGWM8_qjZgTIV4gq8KnzmfsrN-9RsnzPnN5z6FHa-IZ-fb_vsiTnT3-vO15KMW5umZi_eNUia_OCC5uX0xONgT7ZIocSsjX-gqeD_ojQBOaPtOLfvx-a04YQ6p0hsxOPGe3B-ie8t5KOrPf9yFZPlaJgxymsClSlMiopKdK0yqkkdGM0H4Huly06Qrj-k-XDXf0FWaLTSRY_vhKprCKQT5gSV4nFEXVSmofT0mZ9i2TeWAJwAdaq9VBbq5-sVnxhsJ5ELjhGwzFpDLVukLV-r_jIONz3XBU5erZjpeUgJwgg2_9mmTwqXHQjWgg9nsvambQuy9CzigwZ-dBj6MIY5sn2HzN4Ky5z48FhB2sVvk8JA%3D%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. ---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=189837a4c23d4cc6a161d670bff7914d&_e=NQBGaMy_mrczhpebEzrKFPgpXESDeR2Bxkx4cwRD5JlnBVutSGHpi4zurqb3ayARrGslqhJZXbU_M5QBNLSJSZ1C7m21Az4_MwRMMKUvhcGAMwkNI-Z4NbERmwcr9gTkVMNBDKCzJV9O76cahVErlnBg7anX2kr2UjeZDIdD5J1DKwhnfDaowt8PpRgVXdc-JqJh8RXMZcmjTS74aoHoz9ra1lvcntbJRFj10XGmHnA27ESNarqMxIjr7Z6AX-H2EvhUt3YdmCe46IQyknLRUlPrtcWnmuEhBJw2tNQoToph4cZoG3YLxFfu23ks54Hf2sde2arPQb8Ukc7XwriSBH6V3SbgIgmeJ1eZol08VhmpY2x4nqwYv2QAcbsNeCPjxSFFwiWHXxtOGORYw81SrM62RsY1yXIGLWsrKQ16J8VXTONuqr4YM7HdRM9rRpGNaWV6Naf4v9OKJQhY1jtcOQ%3D%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. But desperate times call for desperate measures. And if that's what it'll take to win, I'm willing to chase down every lead.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Joe Biden and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?

# [Tell Ted Cruz: We're not buying your BS about IVF! >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T795dc357-4061-4cb6-8258-cc71715aa46c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1d1f6602-2d4e-481a-86d9-7e73f4c2bcfa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Ted Cruz will do just about anything to get reelected (remember when he threw his support behind Trump after Trump called Cruz's wife ugly?) so now that he's feeling the pressure from his opponent, Democrat Colin Allred, he's pretending to care about protecting in vitro fertilization (IVF). In a desperate attempt to seem more reasonable on reproductive rights, Cruz and Republican Sen. Katie Britt introduced a bill to "clear up confusion after an Alabama Supreme Court ruling" on IVF. But the bill is a sham, as reported by [Daily Kos](https://default.salsalabs.org/T675e898f-ec6e-4608-b3a5-c26f44ce1c56/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9): _It's worth noting what is missing from the proposed legislation from Cruz and Britt: any real legal protections for IVF or an established right to seek assistive reproductive care. Instead, it would strip federal Medicaid money away from states that ban IVF, a "solution" that would hurt tens if not hundreds of thousands of people in those states. That's hardly a deterrent for the red states where IVF bans would be likely, since their lawmakers already don't give a damn about people on Medicaid._ We can see right through Ted Cruz and we're not buying his BS – this is clearly a last-ditch effort to win some votes from people he's pretending to care about. [**We need to send him a message loud and clear: We're not buying your BS about IVF! Add your name now >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tef18531c-4697-41f2-81bc-76734037428c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| For Immediate Release: May 23th, 2024 Contact: John Andrews John@state-local.com

|

Mike Soboleski Announces Endorsement of Bob Emrich
---
| Phillips, Maine- Mike Soboleski proudly announces the endorsement of Pastor Bob Emrich, a distinguished and respected Pastor, community and state leader.
"I respect him and think he will represent Maine well...Mike has the age and experience. I think that Mike is our best choice for a number of reasons. I like his character, I liked talking to him. He was very open and very committed to the issues that he believes in, and we need that more than ever." Said Emrich on [The George Hale Ric Tyler Show this morning.](https://eqbp6ugbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001TeAyuQvGEMR7fmYCkaFKNqOPyxilmrl8UoYLi1fl1Sccs4cURsKNEOSbb5HSPPWSCHUOPuDkYdlOk2AlBpdWgE61uv5AhcGl1tGQ9p-bhWA2aXkcXyBe-sLwMcGToOhABHFfv5mw6imbwXoidU-n1Xa4E5zZE6CEfEXDQDpuYDjAPOCH7CCUPSMRIOYLR-9tyJ6gKZnZQ66Dr7Y6z5oVNaEIGNpaX9Ch&c=QByU2ZNTBUZrAPHb4fyCIA8W5rDmaUMchfnrRFA6UeI5p7WLepC7FQ==&ch=IbLx7Ho-ZaieoDBooxSm7_ceuDcqtkOcsBh5D2Ss-6uwperdNq7FQA==)
He continued, "...Washington DC is a tough place, and you have to be tough and experienced, you have to recognize what people are like good and bad, it's a lot of pressure to face and I think Mike is better prepared for that."
Pastor Bob Emrich has led Emmanuel Bible Baptist Church in Plymouth since 1993. He has served as Chief of Staff for the Maine State Senate Republicans and is a board member of both the National Right to Life and the Maine Right to Life Committee. As Director of the Hope and Mercy Mission in Uganda, He trains pastors and church leaders. He also founded the Maine Jeremiah Project, now part of the Maine Christian Civic League, promoting informed prayer and Christian action in public policy.
"I'm humbled and honored to have the endorsement of Pastor Emrich, one of the most respected and prominent members of the Christian community. I've learned so much from great leaders across the state like Pastor Emrich, Dale Crafts, and Rob Cross. I have spent a lot of time over the past year with a lot of my friends and colleagues of faith, I have been to church a lot more. I am pro-life and a Catholic and my views align with the Catholic faith.
Our message is resignating across the entire district, people are learning who I am and our momentum is building. "

Mike Soboleski Commands final Debate
---
| Norway, Maine- Mike Soboleski, emerged victorious in the final Republican primary debate, solidifying his position as the frontrunner in the race.
Throughout the debate, Soboleski demonstrated clear leadership, comprehensive policy knowledge, and a strong commitment to values that resonate with the voters in Maine's second Congressional district. Soboleski effectively articulated his vision for immigration, energy independence, curbing the drug problem, and campaign finance:
"My opponent said he is "for Dreamers." On June 15, 2012, President Obama announced [DACA](https://eqbp6ugbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EpsUO-F-eSbC2QDKF9djZF_ShJyWc45Zv25v0F2No_ecVl7xisHx_3GBeqQ9ecqhgXOH8IRiNam_oF_3g-ArlBk4h6RAPm9QP_Dt_umne-JpgD2jqSDUQrpUrGYQCAjQJROZ9KZ10x7BbeImmKx7J-8v7J0sIceMg6IjJK03iE1_9p655r8jUg10JLYPwcc5fuyMMpaIZvU-Lr7ILSCasll6TbcBTfzl&c=iUTOZI25r0M07S2ffMDn4xJUm_mKeGiyzUoQDZLfpPACejL2_svYXg==&ch=Rj5Ci91Ov1uevtyzAgB1pMgGyoXyTPN4aXtJwg178H-2VaX3kfiT_Q==), an executive action to lift the shadow of deportation for young people who came to the United States as undocumented immigrants. I support securing our border and legal immigration." "I voted against foreign energy, my opponent [voted for it](https://eqbp6ugbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EpsUO-F-eSbC2QDKF9djZF_ShJyWc45Zv25v0F2No_ecVl7xisHx_3GBeqQ9ecqhIH7-5gAGpyaFFiS9nREGrsstQ-EKFGNMNZm9av72FGVpTVNrvUx1qiBBgk2n2pqgGgkJ6B0hCLCDlD67L3pHTpjxMvDvSETQAXjLUae16zO9gspMCJgvkQ==&c=iUTOZI25r0M07S2ffMDn4xJUm_mKeGiyzUoQDZLfpPACejL2_svYXg==&ch=Rj5Ci91Ov1uevtyzAgB1pMgGyoXyTPN4aXtJwg178H-2VaX3kfiT_Q==)"
"When it comes to injection sites I voted against safe injection my opponent [voted for it](https://eqbp6ugbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EpsUO-F-eSbC2QDKF9djZF_ShJyWc45Zv25v0F2No_ecVl7xisHx_3GBeqQ9ecqhJiuAmA0fxESJNWrxM_vfnwqwCMv050is4ROHO3sgXsCZtHvsZhzKruMJLxohpzmHJncBoqMxPtmvxrFOKAYUM3hcGN6-FyQrTD9ax7nhv9nCuKy2bWW9aYLJiMSh8JmvyMvKcWRFPEM=&c=iUTOZI25r0M07S2ffMDn4xJUm_mKeGiyzUoQDZLfpPACejL2_svYXg==&ch=Rj5Ci91Ov1uevtyzAgB1pMgGyoXyTPN4aXtJwg178H-2VaX3kfiT_Q==). Safe injection sites are not tools." Said Soboleski
Being in Congress is all about character, experience, and forward-thinking to get things done. When it comes to finance and congressional ethics, "I'm for banning stock trading, there should be a 5-year waiting period before anyone in Congress can lobby, and no PAC money, I am for term limits and have signed the term limits agreement."
"This debate was yet another significant milestone for the campaign", said Soboleski. "I am grateful for the opportunity to share my vision with the voters of Maine and highlight the critical issues that we must address together. I have spent a lot of time over the past year with a lot of my friends and colleagues of faith, I have been to church a lot more. If there is any question, I am pro-life and a Catholic. How do you respond to horrid bigotry, especially when it's endorsed by the wealthiest man on Earth? **Let 's Address This.**
I share this more personal side of my advocacy for human rights because it is important to me that you, my supporters, see what I see. Let me take you on a short journey with four steps.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..KindQy24YIyJyJhaAO4PIC8dLlk2al7CKfTW8s12Vz8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144896667)
**First, I posted this tweet.** I was frustrated at the double standard and hypocrisy imposed upon Black and brown students in academia.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/22f16b76-887a-486f-87f6-0fa9ba546752?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Second, the tweet gained popularity, ultimately gaining over 6000 retweets.** That drew the attention of a white supremacist and Islamophobe too weak minded to respond with logic and facts, so instead he responded with this bigoted, hateful vitriol and slur, highlighted in yellow. Naturally I was disgusted by the vile rhetoric.
> love it! Put the filthy Muslims and ni***ers in their place! inshallawallabingbang
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c6811b85-18cf-4152-a00b-99e62d5b8cb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..KindQy24YIyJyJhaAO4PIC8dLlk2al7CKfTW8s12Vz8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144896667)
**Third, I reported it to Twitter.** I recalled Twitter's content moderation specifically forbids hate and targeting people with slurs. Surely, calling Muslims "filthy" and using the N-word qualified. So, I submitted my report to Twitter exactly as they instructed, expecting Twitter to condemn this grotesque white supremacy and Islamophobia.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9d86eac2-acb6-4cad-843b-594a2636db10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/65b276ec-4cd7-4586-b492-29e843bbf368?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Fourth, and much to my dismay, Twitter responded in full agreement with the white supremacist.** Here was Twitter's response, highlighted in yellow:
> After reviewing the available information, we determined that there were no violations of the X rules in the content you reported.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/689e82f4-6a89-4348-aca5-045c893a1748?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..KindQy24YIyJyJhaAO4PIC8dLlk2al7CKfTW8s12Vz8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144896667)
There is so much to unpack here.
**First, let me reemphasize my appreciation to each of you for supporting my work and advocacy.** Whether you subscribe for free or at $5/mo, your support to keep building is critical because, as you can see, these social media platforms are going full blown Nazi.
**Second, how ironic, or perhaps appropriate, that the response I get to condemning racism is Islamophobic anti-Black racism?** And how much more appropriate that the response to condemning systemic racism in America, is receiving racism that is then backed up by systemic white supremacy vis a vis Twitter's approval?
**Third and finally, here 's how we respond. We speak up loudly. We cannot sit silent, but must continue to speak out.** Silence enables bigotry and extremism. Likewise, we tell our stories and share our stories. We can never let such hate be normalized. Be present for others as they share their stories, and be proud and courageous in sharing your stories of overcoming hate. Finally, invest in a future committed to justice and compassion. Whether that's by volunteering for a local candidate you believe in, supporting a non-profit doing the work on an issue important to you, or even subscribing to someone like me so I can continue to counter misinformation and hate and replace it with education and dialogue--all of it matters and is effective.
You have my promise to always speak up and uphold justice above all else, period. Likewise, I encourage you to share your story, speak up, and build your network against hate and bigotry. Let us continue to demand that more humane and just future for this generation and the next. _**Are you in?**_

That’s not something you can give speeches or write a book about.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50997?refcode=em20240523-5585&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5585%2E614464%2EI6Eiy1)
Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm, born-and-raised Missourian.
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[chip in $10 or whatever you can afford toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Missouri.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50997?refcode=em20240523-5585&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5585%2E614464%2EI6Eiy1) But first, please give me a moment to explain what my home state is up against in this election and why I’m supporting Lucas.**
**[CHIP IN TO SUPPORT LUCAS KUNCE →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50997?refcode=em20240523-5585&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5585%2E614464%2EI6Eiy1)**
Most of my family is from a town called Ste. Genevieve. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years.
While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities.
**Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example.**
Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in out-of-touch culture wars and selling us his book all about “manhood” — telling the whole world that the only way to be a man is to be exactly like him.
Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can give speeches or write a book about.
Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us.
**That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage.
Lucas knows courage is about standing up to the powerful and working to rebuild our state. And he knows real leaders fight to empower everyday people and secure our future for generations to come — not for their own power or profit.
**So Peter, if you want to be told about manhood, some guy wrote a book about it.[But if you want someone to show you real courage, please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce’s campaign for U.S. Senate by chipping in $10 or whatever you can afford today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50997?refcode=em20240523-5585&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5585%2E614464%2EI6Eiy1)**

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=74b9d97389-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

ICYMI: What You Need to Know Before the Illinois GOP Convention (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/what-you-need-to-know-before-the-illinois-gop-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=74b9d97389-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

By Thomas McCullagh, Publisher

The Illinois State Republican Convention is fast approaching, set to take place on Friday, May 24, and Saturday, May 25, at the Gateway Convention Center in Collinsville, IL. This event will gather Republicans from across the state for networking, socializing, training, and learning opportunities. However, beyond these activities, the convention holds significant importance as it offers delegates a unique opportunity to influence the direction of the party for the next four years. The main tasks will include adopting a new platform and electing Illinois representatives to the Republican National Committee (RNC).

Understanding the rules and mechanics of the convention is vital for those attending. The opportunity for grassroots participants and delegates to impact the party’s direction is scheduled for only 3.5 hours on Saturday afternoon. This brief window makes it essential for delegates to be well-versed in the rules. Without this knowledge, decisions about the platform and the selection of RNC members could be dominated by those who wrote the rules, rather than by the delegates themselves.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/what-you-need-to-know-before-the-illinois-gop-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=74b9d97389-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/what-you-need-to-know-before-the-illinois-gop-convention.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=74b9d97389-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

The first order of business at the convention will be adopting the Rules of Order. These rules are crucial as they determine how officers are nominated and elected, how the platform is approved and adopted, and much more. Essentially, the adopted rules will decide who gets their voices heard and who has the power to influence key decisions.

For delegates who wish to challenge the proposed rules, the time to act is when the convention is called to order. According to the current bylaws of the Illinois Republican Party, specifically Articles VI and VII, the convention itself has the authority to set its own rules. This means that unless delegates propose and adopt alternate rules at the opening of the convention, the rules proposed by the Rules and Procedures committee will be enacted. These rules will then govern the adoption of the platform and the nomination and election of members to the RNC.

Per Article VII (H) of the bylaws, the proposed convention rules must be published on the Illinois Republican Party website and made available in printed form to each delegation chair forty-eight hours before the convention opens.

With the general business session starting at 11:30 AM on Saturday, the rules should be published by 11:30 AM TODAY.

These rules will then govern the adoption of the platform and the nomination and election of members to the RNC. Per Article VII (H) of the bylaws, the proposed convention rules must be published on the Illinois Republican Party website and made available in printed form to each delegation chair forty-eight hours before the convention opens. With the general business session starting at 11:30 AM on Saturday, the rules should be published by 11:30 AM TODAY. name: Tom Fitton
subject: Our New Election Lawsuit...This is What We're Up Against!
body:
When Judicial Watch sues states over their failure to clean their voter rolls, we mean business!

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

When Judicial Watch sues states over their failure to clean their voter rolls, we mean business!
That's why we just filed a _new_ lawsuit to force **California** to clean its voter rolls after we uncovered a broad failure to clean up voter rolls in dozens of the state's counties.
Our historic 2017 lawsuit and settlement with **California** led to the removal of _over 1.2 million ineligible voter_ s in Los Angeles County alone..._but our research and our new lawsuit shows there is[still more work to do](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68417&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_.
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68417&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

When we achieve a settlement with a state about cleaning its voter rolls...which is the single best defense against voter fraud..._we don't just walk away_.

Our election law team, which is the best in the business, keeps monitoring to be sure the settlements are being honored.

And they are constantly analyzing the most up-to-date election data to determine if in other counties and states the number of _registered_ voters exceeds the Census counts of _eligible_ voters...which leads us to issue "warnings" and if necessary file lawsuits.

This is hard, time-consuming work..._and it is expensive_!

[**That's why I am so hopeful you will make a tax-deductible contribution to help us today.**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68417&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68417&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

With the generous support of our members, Judicial Watch has already forced the removal of more than **4.4 million** ineligible voters from voter rolls across the country...

..._and that means we have eliminated more than**4.4 million** opportunities for voter fraud in this election year_!

I don't believe that any of our work fighting for the rule of law is more important than our fight for honest elections.

And we must always be fully prepared to take on new challenges in this fight...because if Judicial Watch doesn't take on those challenges, _no one else will_.

It is really that simple, and it is why I urge you to **_[add to your support today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68417&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_**. _We can 't do this election integrity work without you_.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68417&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Please help us _fight for you and for the rule of law_ with even more impact.

And if you do, I want you to know that every day all of us at Judicial Watch will be working to honor your trust in us.

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68417&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

name: Karen Crnkovich
subject: It's official ✅
body:
✅ It’s official: I’m on the ballot in Kansas and my campaign is heating up. I am so encouraged and grateful for the incredible momentum and grassroots support that is building.

Deciding to run for Congress for KS-03 was not a decision I made lightly. I’m not a politician, and I’ve never run for office before...

I am a concerned citizen who was frustrated with the state of our nation... and decided to do something to fix it. After all, I own an HVAC company, so I know a thing or two about fixing dysfunctional systems.

So I got to work studying the issues, talking to civic and business leaders, attending over 1,000 community meetings, and going through extensive trainings that prepared me not just to win... but also to serve effectively.

Hard work, dedication, and perseverance are three things I value and apply to my daily life.

I am a stepmom to a Gen Z college student, a small business owner of an HVAC company, and the founder of a non-profit that helps homeowners in need with critical home repairs.

I am an active member of my church and community, such as the Kansas City Chamber of Commerce, the Plumbing-Heating-Cooling Contractors Association, the Associated Builders and Contractors, the Kansas Federation of Republican Women, and many more.

I am an alum of the Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program, and my company was recognized as a Greater Kansas City Chamber of Commerce Top 10 Small Business two years in a row.

All that’s to say that I have the relevant experience needed to fix the problems we’re dealing with... the work ethic to get the job done... and the genuine desire to serve, not just fill a seat.

This race is critical, as this seat could determine control of Congress. And the primary is coming up quickly—August 6.

But I am not being propped up by Washington Power Brokers and funded by special interests. My campaign is backed by the people who matter: you.

Here are the TOP 5 ways you can help me win right now:

1\. Please spread the word and [share my website](http://www.kcforkansas.com) with anyone interested in getting involved
2\. Please consider volunteering - [sign up here](https://forms.gle/LW8MFx3hUnFDvNhW8)
3\. On June 15th signs will go up - [click here to receive a sign](https://forms.gle/oyBbFgnxaRUGXF3t8)
4\. Please follow me on social media and share my posts:
Facebook: @KCforKansas
Instagram: @KCforKansas2024
Twitter/X: @KCforKansas
YouTube: @KCforKansas
5\. Please consider making a contribution by [clicking here](https://secure.winred.com/karen-crnkovich-for-congress/donate), as EVERY SINGLE dollar makes a difference and is greatly appreciated

Thank you so much for taking the time to read this. I hope to earn your support.

Best,

Karen Crnkovich
Candidate for Congress (KS-03)

[www.kcforkansas.com](http://www.kcforkansas.com/) ____
913-414-4446
#teamkc

_As always, if you no longer wish to receive these updates, please reply STOP and we will remove you from our list immediately._
