# The Frederick Douglass Celebration
A Great American, A Great Republican
---
| **Frederick Douglass Alive****by Don Pesci**
---
[Subscribe to Don' Pescis Substack ](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=19361be26e&e=8763c56857)
| Frederick Douglass has much to teach us about what slavery and prejudice is, how to combat both and, most importantly, how to secure our human liberty. A critic once slammed G. K. Chesterton’s view of the world as upside down. Chesterton responded that the world of his day was upside down and, to view it properly, one must stand on one’s head. Douglas stood on his feet and saw within reach a vision of the world that was his constant companion.Douglas’ letter to Thomas Auld, once his slave master, rights an upside down world. Douglass published his letter in North Star, an abolitionist newspaper he had founded in 1847.
Even at six years old, Douglass, then a slave, was perplexed when he had asked himself why he was a slave. Sometime later, “I heard some of the old slaves talking of their parents having been stolen from Africa by white men, and were sold here as slaves. The whole mystery was solved at once. Very soon after this my Aunt Jinny and Uncle Noah ran away, and the great noise made about it by your father-in-law, [the father-in-law of the slave master] made me for the first time acquainted with the fact, that there were free States as well as slave States. From that time, I resolved that I would someday run away. The morality of the act, I dispose as follows: I am myself; you are yourself; we are two distinct persons, equal persons. What you are, I am. You are a man, and so am I. God created both, and made us separate beings. I am not by nature bound to you, or you to me. Nature does not make your existence depend upon me, or mine to depend upon yours. I cannot walk upon your legs, or you upon mine. I cannot breathe for you, or you for me; I must breathe for myself, and you for yourself. We are distinct persons, and are each equally provided with faculties necessary to our individual existence. In leaving you, I took nothing but what belonged to me, and in no way lessened your means for obtaining an honest living. Your faculties remained yours, and mine became useful to their rightful owner.”Liberty is a gift of God inbred in human nature and is fully understood only when it is claimed as a personal possession. It is this claim of liberty that shatters forever the chains that tie a man to slavery. The will to freedom and independence is irrepressible and stronger than the will to power.During his own day, Douglass was the freest man alive in a nation that held men, women and children as slaves. He escaped his slave master and headed north.
Working on the wharves of New Bedford, Massachusetts, Douglass earned his first honest dollar, a liberating experience: “It was there I earned my first free dollar. It was mine. I could spend it as I pleased. I could buy hams or herring with it, without asking any odds of any body. That was a precious dollar to me.” Marriage was liberating: “I soon, however, learned to count money, as well as to make it, and got on swimmingly. I married soon after leaving you: in fact, I was engaged to be married before I left you; and instead of finding my companion a burden, she was truly a helpmeet. She went to live at service, and I to work on the wharf, and though we toiled hard the first winter, we never lived more happily.” By chance -- or more likely, Douglass thought, by the hand of God -- he met “Wm. Lloyd Garrison, a person of whom you have possibly heard, as he is pretty generally known among slaveholders. He put it into my head that I might make myself serviceable to the cause of the slave by devoting a portion of my time to telling my own sorrows, and those of other slaves which had come under my observation. This was the commencement of a higher state of existence than any to which I had ever aspired.”
Through such winding pathways, he was introduced to an excellent society of like liberty-loving souls, among whom were notable northern abolitionists – such as Henry David Thoreau, the author of “Slavery in Massachusetts”, Julia Ward Howe, who authored “The Battle Hymn of the Republic,” sung to the tune of an older freedom hymn, “[John Brown’s Body](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=74be60dffd&e=8763c56857),” a marching song of northern Civil War troops – and, much later, Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator.
He also met and had some business with John Brown, like him a free man. When he moved from Connecticut to Ohio, Brown astonished his neighbors by giving a pew he had purchased to a black family. In his “[A Plea for Captain John Brown](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=ab81356697&e=8763c56857)”, Thoreau said of Brown, “He would have left a Greek accent slanting the wrong way, and righted up a falling man.”The excellence of the society Douglass moved in “exerted a beneficial influence on my mind and heart. Much of my early dislike of white persons was removed, and their manners, habits and customs, so entirely unlike what I had been used to in the kitchen-quarters on the plantations of the South, fairly charmed me, and gave me a strong disrelish for the coarse and degrading customs of my former condition. I therefore made an effort so to improve my mind and deportment, as to be somewhat fitted to the station to which I seemed almost providentially called. The transition from degradation to respectability was indeed great, and to get from one to the other without carrying some marks of one’s former condition, is truly a difficult matter.”
On this point, Douglass is unsparing: “Oh! sir, a slaveholder never appears to me so completely an agent of hell, as when I think of and look upon my dear children. It is then that my feelings rise above my control. I meant to have said more with respect to my own prosperity and happiness, but thoughts and feelings which this recital has quickened unfits me to proceed further in that direction. The grim horrors of slavery rise in all their ghastly terror before me, the wails of millions pierce my heart, and chill my blood. I remember the chain, the gag, the bloody whip, the deathlike gloom overshadowing the broken spirit of the fettered bondman, the appalling liability of his being torn away from wife and children, and sold like a beast in the market. Say not that this is a picture of fancy. You well know that I wear stripes on my back inflicted by your direction; and that you, while we were brothers in the same church, caused this right hand, with which I am now penning this letter, to be closely tied to my left, and my person dragged at the pistol’s mouth, fifteen miles, from the Bay side to Easton to be sold like a beast in the market, for the alleged crime of intending to escape from your possession. All this and more you remember, and know to be perfectly true, not only of yourself, but of nearly all of the slaveholders around you.”
The Lincoln-Douglass connection is not often remarked upon.Lincoln’s most stirring address is not, to my way of thinking, the Gettysburg Address, but rather his Second Inaugural Address, a few lines of which are engraved on the north wall of the Lincoln Memorial. Lincoln showed his address to Douglas before he delivered it, and Douglas nodded approval of the following lines, engraved on the wall by Evelyn Beatrice Longman: “The Almighty has His own purposes. ‘Woe unto the world because of offenses; for it must needs be that offenses come, but woe to that man by whom the offense cometh.’ If we shall suppose that American slavery is one of those offenses which, in the providence of God, must needs come, but which, having continued through His appointed time, He now wills to remove, and that He gives to both North and South this terrible war as the woe due to those by whom the offense came, shall we discern therein any departure from those divine attributes which the believers in a living God always ascribe to Him? Fondly do we hope, fervently do we pray, that this mighty scourge of war may speedily pass away. Yet, if God wills that it continue until all the wealth piled by the bondsman's two hundred and fifty years of unrequited toil shall be sunk, and until every drop of blood drawn with the lash shall be paid by another drawn with the sword, as was said three thousand years ago, so still it must be said ‘the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.’”
Among the crowd present when Lincoln delivered his address was his assassin, John Wilkes Booth.
What Thoreau said of Brown – that he fronted the world without fear of men, but trembled only before a merciful and just God – is also true of Douglass, who loved, in this order, his God, his wife and children, honor and strength, and likeminded servants of light and courage. In running away from the bloody lash of his master, he came to himself at last, overmastered slavery, and met a man who loved liberty rather than servitude at the command of immoral men, honor rather than dishonor, and – though no graduate of Harvard, Thoreau’s alma mater – had wit and intelligence enough to know and follow the truth that set him free.

# Why Frederick Douglass?
---
| **A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

clean_body: An Essay from one of Connecticut's Revered Conservative Authors | | | | | | | | The Frederick Douglass Celebration A Great American, A Great Republican | Frederick Douglass Aliveby Don Pesci | Frederick Douglass has much to teach us about what slavery and prejudice is, how to combat both and, most importantly, how to secure our human liberty. A critic once slammed G. K. Chesterton’s view of the world as upside down. Chesterton responded that the world of his day was upside down and, to view it properly, one must stand on one’s head. Douglas stood on his feet and saw within reach a vision of the world that was his constant companion.Douglas’ letter to Thomas Auld, once his slave master, rights an upside down world. Douglass published his letter in North Star, an abolitionist newspaper he had founded in 1847. Even at six years old, Douglass, then a slave, was perplexed when he had asked himself why he was a slave. Sometime later, “I heard some of the old slaves talking of their parents having been stolen from Africa by white men, and were sold here as slaves. The whole mystery was solved at once. Very soon after this my Aunt Jinny and Uncle Noah ran away, and the great noise made about it by your father-in-law, [the father-in-law of the slave master] made me for the first time acquainted with the fact, that there were free States as well as slave States. From that time, I resolved that I would someday run away. The morality of the act, I dispose as follows: I am myself; you are yourself; we are two distinct persons, equal persons. What you are, I am. You are a man, and so am I. God created both, and made us separate beings. I am not by nature bound to you, or you to me. Nature does not make your existence depend upon me, or mine to depend upon yours. I cannot walk upon your legs, or you upon mine. I cannot breathe for you, or you for me; I must breathe for myself, and you for yourself. We are distinct persons, and are each equally provided with faculties necessary to our individual existence. In leaving you, I took nothing but what belonged to me, and in no way lessened your means for obtaining an honest living. Your faculties remained yours, and mine became useful to their rightful owner.”Liberty is a gift of God inbred in human nature and is fully understood only when it is claimed as a personal possession. It is this claim of liberty that shatters forever the chains that tie a man to slavery. The will to freedom and independence is irrepressible and stronger than the will to power.During his own day, Douglass was the freest man alive in a nation that held men, women and children as slaves. He escaped his slave master and headed north. Working on the wharves of New Bedford, Massachusetts, Douglass earned his first honest dollar, a liberating experience: “It was there I earned my first free dollar. It was mine. I could spend it as I pleased. I could buy hams or herring with it, without asking any odds of any body. That was a precious dollar to me.” Marriage was liberating: “I soon, however, learned to count money, as well as to make it, and got on swimmingly. I married soon after leaving you: in fact, I was engaged to be married before I left you; and instead of finding my companion a burden, she was truly a helpmeet. She went to live at service, and I to work on the wharf, and though we toiled hard the first winter, we never lived more happily.” By chance -- or more likely, Douglass thought, by the hand of God -- he met “Wm. Lloyd Garrison, a person of whom you have possibly heard, as he is pretty generally known among slaveholders. He put it into my head that I might make myself serviceable to the cause of the slave by devoting a portion of my time to telling my own sorrows, and those of other slaves which had come under my observation. This was the commencement of a higher state of existence than any to which I had ever aspired.” Through such winding pathways, he was introduced to an excellent society of like liberty-loving souls, among whom were notable northern abolitionists – such as Henry David Thoreau, the author of “Slavery in Massachusetts”, Julia Ward Howe, who authored “The Battle Hymn of the Republic,” sung to the tune of an older freedom hymn, “,” a marching song of northern Civil War troops – and, much later, Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator. He also met and had some business with John Brown, like him a free man. When he moved from Connecticut to Ohio, Brown astonished his neighbors by giving a pew he had purchased to a black family. In his “”, Thoreau said of Brown, “He would have left a Greek accent slanting the wrong way, and righted up a falling man.”The excellence of the society Douglass moved in “exerted a beneficial influence on my mind and heart. Much of my early dislike of white persons was removed, and their manners, habits and customs, so entirely unlike what I had been used to in the kitchen-quarters on the plantations of the South, fairly charmed me, and gave me a strong disrelish for the coarse and degrading customs of my former condition. I therefore made an effort so to improve my mind and deportment, as to be somewhat fitted to the station to which I seemed almost providentially called. The transition from degradation to respectability was indeed great, and to get from one to the other without carrying some marks of one’s former condition, is truly a difficult matter.” On this point, Douglass is unsparing: “Oh! sir, a slaveholder never appears to me so completely an agent of hell, as when I think of and look upon my dear children. It is then that my feelings rise above my control. I meant to have said more with respect to my own prosperity and happiness, but thoughts and feelings which this recital has quickened unfits me to proceed further in that direction. The grim horrors of slavery rise in all their ghastly terror before me, the wails of millions pierce my heart, and chill my blood. I remember the chain, the gag, the bloody whip, the deathlike gloom overshadowing the broken spirit of the fettered bondman, the appalling liability of his being torn away from wife and children, and sold like a beast in the market. Say not that this is a picture of fancy. You well know that I wear stripes on my back inflicted by your direction; and that you, while we were brothers in the same church, caused this right hand, with which I am now penning this letter, to be closely tied to my left, and my person dragged at the pistol’s mouth, fifteen miles, from the Bay side to Easton to be sold like a beast in the market, for the alleged crime of intending to escape from your possession. All this and more you remember, and know to be perfectly true, not only of yourself, but of nearly all of the slaveholders around you.” The Lincoln-Douglass connection is not often remarked upon.Lincoln’s most stirring address is not, to my way of thinking, the Gettysburg Address, but rather his Second Inaugural Address, a few lines of which are engraved on the north wall of the Lincoln Memorial. Lincoln showed his address to Douglas before he delivered it, and Douglas nodded approval of the following lines, engraved on the wall by Evelyn Beatrice Longman: “The Almighty has His own purposes. ‘Woe unto the world because of offenses; for it must needs be that offenses come, but woe to that man by whom the offense cometh.’ If we shall suppose that American slavery is one of those offenses which, in the providence of God, must needs come, but which, having continued through His appointed time, He now wills to remove, and that He gives to both North and South this terrible war as the woe due to those by whom the offense came, shall we discern therein any departure from those divine attributes which the believers in a living God always ascribe to Him? Fondly do we hope, fervently do we pray, that this mighty scourge of war may speedily pass away. Yet, if God wills that it continue until all the wealth piled by the bondsman's two hundred and fifty years of unrequited toil shall be sunk, and until every drop of blood drawn with the lash shall be paid by another drawn with the sword, as was said three thousand years ago, so still it must be said ‘the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.’” Among the crowd present when Lincoln delivered his address was his assassin, John Wilkes Booth. What Thoreau said of Brown – that he fronted the world without fear of men, but trembled only before a merciful and just God – is also true of Douglass, who loved, in this order, his God, his wife and children, honor and strength, and likeminded servants of light and courage. In running away from the bloody lash of his master, he came to himself at last, overmastered slavery, and met a man who loved liberty rather than servitude at the command of immoral men, honor rather than dishonor, and – though no graduate of Harvard, Thoreau’s alma mater – had wit and intelligence enough to know and follow the truth that set him free. | Come Celebrate Frederick Douglass’s Legacy with us on June 5th | | | Why Frederick Douglass? | A Force for Uniting the United States: Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War. Believed in American Principles: History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds. A Symbol of Republican Values: Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Despite being an incumbent, progressive champion Rep. Jamaal Bowman is the
underdog in his June Democratic primary. Last week alone, AIPAC’s super
PAC United Democracy Project dropped nearly $2 million in ads attacking
Jamaal and supporting his conservative opponent, George Latimer.

Now, UDP is up to $5.9 million in reserved ad spending in New York’s 16th
congressional district — the most they’ve EVER spent in a single race.

With help from AIPAC’s Republican megadonors and other dark money groups,
outside spending for Latimer is now over 20 times more than the amount
being spent in support of Jamaal. That’s a problem.

Between now and the June 25th primary, AIPAC’s network will flood the
airwaves of NY-16 with lies and misinformation to smear Jamaal while
claiming Latimer will fight MAGA extremists as he takes money from them.

Latimer may have a bigger war chest thanks to AIPAC’s right-wing
millionaire and billionaire donors, but we have you: the people.

We overcame the odds to elect Jamaal and other members of the Squad
before, and we can do it again this June if enough people chip in what
they can when they can.

| | What did the MAGA Republicans accomplish in the State Capitol this year?

* **Reduced funding for our schools** \- why? To pay for their for-profit private school vouchers.
* **Pride Flag BANNED.** But the racist confederate flag was proudly supported by them.

| Hamburgers or Memorials?

Peter, you don’t have to choose – Take time to do BOTH!

While I hope you will be enjoying a hamburger with family and friends this weekend, I also hope that you will remember the reason for our “Monday Off.”

**One great way to memorialize the sacrifices made for our freedoms is to** _**march in a Memorial Day Parade**_ with a group who is truly thankful for our freedoms protected by our American Heroes!

My family, friends, and I are walking in three parades this weekend – Would you join us?
---

| | We wear green Neil Parrott shirts or Military shirts, vests, and hats, wave American flags, and help others to celebrate this great American Holiday.

* Saturday, May 25, in Sharpsburg at 2pm, 1pm line-up,
* Sunday, May 26, in Woodsboro at 1:30pm, 1pm line-up,
* Sunday, May 26, in Boonsboro at 2pm, 1pm line-up.

Let us know if you can join us. We’d love to walk with you!

In the heartfelt words of Lee Greenwood, “I’m proud to be an American, where at least I know I’m free. And I won’t forget the men who died, who gave that right to me.”

I love our country, and I believe you do, too. Standing with you this weekend, as we stand for those who came before us.

For our country,
Neil

# A new Congressman for SC-7.

I'm Mal Hyman and I'm running for Congress (SC-7) to bring more common sense for the common good - for all of our country.
I've taught in public schools, men’s prisons and for three decades at Coker University in Hartsville. I've served on civic boards, launched a local Earth Day celebration, monitored human rights in Central America and the Middle East and written a book on national security.
We confront the most critical time in our nation's history dating back to the Civil War.
Washington's long been broken, poisoned by money and GOP parlor games and partisanship. Here's what you and I know, though: America's story is one of redemption - and 'we, the people" are generally the redeemers.
Common sense for the common good means pragmatic, progressive solutions like:
* increasing the minimum wage and ensuring it’s a living wage;
* enshrining healthcare as a human right;
* restoring women’s reproductive rights;
* making childcare, college and trade school education affordable;
* expanding veterans’ access to care;
* strengthening Social Security;
* creating a fair, humane and secure immigration system;
* protecting our environment.

I believe that strengthens families, communities and our economy. This means the wealthy and corporations must pay their fair share, so that we can responsibly invest enough to restore the American Dream.
I won't take a dime in corporate donations, because no one can serve two masters. That said, we know that democracy is a team sport; so come join our team! Our primary is June 11th. Can we count on you? Please chip in whatever you can to help take back the House poisoned by money and Republican chaos.
**Everything sacred is on the ballot this year: democracy, dignity and our greatest strength - our diversity.**
Learn more at malhyman.com

[Donate](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=c7cf2d3397&e=5d7e9a146c)

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Peter, I really need your help if we’re going to take back Arizona’s Senate seat
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
When I was serving in the Marines, I never thought I’d be in this position. On patrol in Al Anbar, Iraq, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.
#

Peter —
I’ve got to be honest with you. I never thought this is how it’d go.
When I was sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never thought I’d be running for Senate someday. All I knew was that I was going to have to work my butt off to get into a good school — after that, I had no idea.
When I was serving in the Marines, I never thought I’d be in this position. On patrol in Al Anbar, Iraq, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.
Even today, I never thought hundreds of thousands of people would contribute and volunteer to help elect me.
And I never thought I’d need to ask supporters like you to do more than that to help me take back Arizona’s Senate seat.
But I need to ask you to do more. We’re facing the first major attacks of the race, a television buy of $10 million from Lake and the NRSC. The former president is attacking me directly. And we’ve missed a few fundraising goals already this year.
So, please... You probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to win in Arizona.
[**Can you PLEASE make your first online contribution to my campaign ahead of Memorial Day? We have to stay on track to our goals, and I know it will be tough while folks are taking time off this weekend.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-may24.hD4hyN&refcode=em240523-1-160&t=1&akid=2372%2E734936%2EBHCduH)

Peter,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

**Well, Peter, I took those same ideals I learned as a Waffle House waitress to Congress. I refuse to waiver to what anyone wants other than the constituents I was elected by,_even if it means pissing off some party members along the way._**

I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it. | Peter, My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, "Nothing will work unless you do". And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table. Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it. Well, Peter, I took those same ideals I learned as a Waffle House waitress to Congress. I refuse to waiver to what anyone wants other than the constituents I was elected by,even if it means pissing off some party members along the way. - someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. body:
Since becoming the Democratic nominee for Senate here in Maryland, we’ve received thousands of grassroots donations from folks who are ready to do whatever it takes to defeat Larry Hogan and keep this seat blue.

But here’s the thing: The GOP is celebrating, too.

Hogan is Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate for this race, and it’s going to be incredibly difficult to defeat him and the dark money super PACs behind his campaign.

Whoever capitalizes on this momentum right now will have a huge advantage in the weeks and months ahead, which is why we set an ambitious General Election Founding Donor Goal. Will you chip in a split donation of $10 between my campaign and Seth Moulton to make sure we hit it? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-alsobrooks]

Hogan’s victory is a win for the MAGA agenda.

Mitch McConnell got his guy, and now he sees an opportunity to flip this seat red, retake the Senate, and pass a national abortion ban.

But if we win in November, we’ve got a shot at defending our narrow Senate majority, which means we could restore and expand abortion rights, lower costs for families, and empower workers and unions.

It’s going to take all of the grassroots supporters who got us here — plus we need to bring even more folks into our nationwide coalition of support — to make sure we put Larry Hogan on blast.

Hitting our General Election Founding Donor Goal will give us the boost we need right out of the gate to spread our campaign message and set the record straight on Hogan. Can I count on you to become a Founding Donor right now by splitting a donation between my campaign and Seth Moulton? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-alsobrooks]

All eyes are on Maryland, and with the Senate majority on the line, they will be right up to Election Day.

So let’s get to work.

—Angela Alsobrooks

| Friend,
I want to share with you the press release that I released yesterday. Bill Foster just voted against the Israel Security Assistance Act. I believe we should be helping our Israeli brothers and sisters, and we need to stand up for them to get the support they need. If you also believe we should stand up for Israel, please read this press release below and [help send me to Washington](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GgvPCFSiP3f8VQUISUsiuCOaOSMww60saVCtLEB_FQVRK9auBk5mAlJMmEep-G8vlIGYu5dAxa1Hpn9n04YezutIyO_Wra-nGVntow6QNOCFhJaT_MVZ65s9Bk4QhHQwh6uS8FFVRA-mLom5YEHEGcIjjy_Ek6rf77s6lCObF66D_sOgBkmIUI7U1m4S4lbFeCqcMcQDZek=&c=zJd4u8hy31vArsPIK5rt0ljNe-k7OgCi-uPkdPOkFL5sBB5YGh-1lQ==&ch=Bc7zEDigcw6iAiis5j-x8NWngZcuWYACOnRlDYfg5eo5vnlVV5cKIw==).
---
| WARRENVILLE, IL - Last week, the US House voted on[ H.R. 8369](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GgvPCFSiP3f8VQUISUsiuCOaOSMww60saVCtLEB_FQVRK9auBk5mAmH9iT4EZzVd4-iAmrGVpjRdZHXuFXaHeUI-K03bPYdWXpi89FWIqz04FoNLVt4Ff18AtJlTgzgOdn5_xYtNmt_wzorZtfvIP1g7u-QHKzgKl9jvd5M6Bg8=&c=zJd4u8hy31vArsPIK5rt0ljNe-k7OgCi-uPkdPOkFL5sBB5YGh-1lQ==&ch=Bc7zEDigcw6iAiis5j-x8NWngZcuWYACOnRlDYfg5eo5vnlVV5cKIw==) the Israel Security Assistance Support Act. Congressman Bill Foster joined with progressive Democrats and [voted against](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GgvPCFSiP3f8VQUISUsiuCOaOSMww60saVCtLEB_FQVRK9auBk5mAmH9iT4EZzVd4-iAmrGVpjRdZHXuFXaHeUI-K03bPYdWXpi89FWIqz04FoNLVt4Ff18AtJlTgzgOdn5_xYtNmt_wzorZtfvIP1g7u-QHKzgKl9jvd5M6Bg8=&c=zJd4u8hy31vArsPIK5rt0ljNe-k7OgCi-uPkdPOkFL5sBB5YGh-1lQ==&ch=Bc7zEDigcw6iAiis5j-x8NWngZcuWYACOnRlDYfg5eo5vnlVV5cKIw==) sending much needed support to Israel.

| | Once again, Oregon has held a successful election using Vote by Mail. Nobody waited in long lines. There were no unusual voting machine shortages in certain precincts. Everyone who wanted to vote got to vote from the comfort of their own homes and send back their ballots in a postage-paid envelope. **_Vote by Mail has worked for decades._** Oregonians have been voting by mail for over 20 years, and it's why we consistently have some of the highest rates of voter participation in the country. It's safe, secure, and leaves a paper trail — and there's no waiting in long lines or bad weather to cast a ballot. It's past time for Vote by Mail to be the law of the land, and when we pass the Freedom to Vote Act, it will be. The strength of our democracy depends on Americans' ability to make their voices heard. That's why I'm championing the Freedom to Vote Act to help expand voting by mail, early voting, and other reforms to make voting easier and more secure. It's 2024, and MAGA Republicans across the United States are rolling back common-sense voting laws and implementing new restrictions to disenfranchise voters of color, younger voters, and anyone they think will vote against their extreme, out-of-touch agenda. The ballot box is the beating heart of our democracy, and we need to be doing everything we can to protect and expand access to it. I know you're with me in this fight because we know Vote by Mail is a democracy issue, not a political issue. I'll keep doing everything I can to pass the Freedom to Vote Act, take Vote by Mail nationwide, and make sure all Americans can have their voices heard in our democracy. | | **For immediate release:** May 23, 2024
**Contact:** press@davemin.com
**Blue state Dems look to buck party's crime policies, get major backing from police groups in swing races**
_Crime has become a central theme in many of California's battleground House districts_

**By Brandon Gillespie, Fox News**
A group of Democrats running for Congress in three of California's most competitive swing House districts are trying to flip the script on their party's traditional approach to crime.

Former federal prosecutor Will Rollins, state Sen. Dave Min and former state Assemblyman Adam Gray are making a tough on crime approach central to their campaigns, and they have secured endorsements from a number of law enforcement officials and police groups eager to put an end to the violent crime that has spiked across the deep-blue state in recent years.

Rollins is running to represent California's 41st Congressional District, and last week, he flipped the endorsement of one local police group, the Palm Springs Police Officers Association, from incumbent Republican Rep. Ken Calvert, who it endorsed in 2022.

"We also got endorsed by the International Law Enforcement Officers Association, and got endorsed by the former Republican sheriff in Riverside County ... and the former Republican assembly leader in California. So it's been a big bipartisan coalition this time around, and we're thrilled to have it," Rollins told Fox News Digital in an interview.

Rollins helped prosecute a number of alleged drug traffickers, Iranian sanctions violators and foreign nationals accused of crimes during his time at the Department of Justice under the Obama, Trump and Biden administrations, and he says a commitment to a mission higher than oneself, regardless of party, is what Congress needs.

"I have some Republican colleagues and friends and former coworkers and family members who have talked to me about crime, and I think they've got some good points, and I share their concerns, and I want to make sure that I'm out there talking to voters, expressing my experience as a former federal prosecutor, whether it's going after cartels or trying to stop fentanyl trafficking, or what we should do to modernize our border security," he told Fox.

"I think we need to be more vocal about that as a party, and certainly as candidates for the House of Representatives, so that voters make sure that they understand me as a person, not just my political party, but where I stand from my own life experience," he added.

Min is running to replace Democrat Rep. Katie Porter in California's 47th Congressional District, and he has got the backing of the Peace Officers Research Association, the state's largest police union and the largest statewide association of police officers in the country, as well as the Los Angeles Police Protective League, the Association of Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs and the California Lodge of the Fraternal Order of Police.

He authored a number of bills as a member of the state Senate that he says show his staunch support for police, including ones that targeted California's retail theft problem, domestic violence and crime aboard public transportation. He also touts his efforts to provide more money for local police, while many in the party were pushing to defund law enforcement.

Gray is running to represent California's 13th Congressional District, and he has the backing of Merced County District Attorney Nicole Siveira and Merced County Sheriff Vernon Warnke, who was reportedly considered by the state Republican Party as a potential candidate for governor.

He touts his record on the campaign trail as a "strong supporter of law enforcement" during his time as a member of the state Assembly, including pushing for funding to combat gang violence and retail theft, as well as opposing measures to reduce sentencing guidelines for those convicted of certain crimes.

All three candidates are facing tough paths to victory in a year when a majority in the House of Representatives could hinge on the battleground races taking place in the Golden State.

Empowering change and uniting women's voices
As the campaign trail takes me across Northern Michigan and the UP, it's more clear than ever — we must continue to champion women's rights and ensure access to comprehensive reproductive healthcare.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/drbobforwomensrights [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/drbobforwomensrights]
It's been a privilege of mine to spend my career on the frontlines of women's healthcare, and lately I've been moved witnessing firsthand the power and determination of women leaders in our district.
Friends, to continue our fight, I would be honored to have you in our corner. Large or small, your contributions are crucial to advance Democratic causes in Northern Michigan and the UP, especially women's rights.
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Ezpress, your donation will process immediately.
DONATE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/drbobforwomensrights?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=express_lane_5]

Friends,
Over the last few days, I've been blessed to join forces with some of the most prolific candidates and leaders across rural Michigan.
One of the key aspects of our campaign is coordinating with other remarkable activists and advocates, particularly women running for state and local races. Together, we can empower the voices of those who are leading the fight for a better future in and out of the doctor's office.
A patient's room is much too small for a woman, her doctor, and the entire state or federal government. Bodily autonomy and medical privacy are paramount, and although reproductive care is a top political priority, our efforts don't end there. We're working to:
*
Eliminate
the
gender
pay
gap
*
End
violence
against
women
*
Advocate
for
maternity
leave
and
childcare
*
Dismantle
gender
stereotypes
*
Promote
workplace
and
education
equality
I have four granddaughters — and they shouldn't have to fight the battles their grandmothers already won. They are why I am in this fight.
Thank you to all the remarkable women who have joined our cause. I am grateful for the opportunity to work alongside you in this important journey.
Women's rights are human rights, and I won't stop fighting for a future that enables everyone to truly be free and thrive.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser

Democrat, MI01

The blame lies squarely with AOC and the far-left who took over and made our city unsafe and unaffordable with their radical policies. Join me in donating to and supporting Jonathan, Vote for him on June 18.

Please donate to him as soon as you can: $50, $100, $200, $500 or more.

By Illinois Review

The Illinois Republican Party (ILGOP) is grappling with a pivotal controversy that has emerged just as its State Convention approaches this weekend. The focus is on Vince Kolber, whose eligibility to serve as an RNC national committeeman is under scrutiny. According to the strict bylaws of the ILGOP, a candidate must have participated in the last three Republican primaries in Illinois. However, it appears that Kolber has not met this crucial criterion.

Investigation into Kolber’s voting history reveals that he failed to vote in the 2020 Illinois Republican primary and instead voted in the Wisconsin Republican primary, rendering him potentially ineligible for the nomination. This situation has sparked concerns among party members as they prepare for the Illinois State Republican Convention set for May 24-25 at the Gateway Convention Center in Collinsville, IL.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/vince-kolbers-rnc-candidacy-in-jeopardy-over-dual-state-voting.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7bbcfd4644-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

This incident with Kolber underscores the broader challenges and tensions within the ILGOP, highlighted by recent interactions at party meetings. At a State Central Committee meeting, Kolber, noted for his financial contributions to the party, made controversial remarks that sparked significant backlash from grassroots activists. His comments emphasized a perceived disconnect between party leadership and the grassroots base, further complicating his current predicament.

Kolber’s dual registration in Illinois and Wisconsin also raises legal and ethical questions, echoing past controversies where other prominent figures faced criticism for similar issues. The case of Kolber not only tests the ILGOP’s adherence to its own rules but also reflects the ongoing struggle within the party to align its leadership with the values and expectations of its base.

Friend, today, I want to talk about a young woman who has redefined what it means to be an activist in our time — Greta Thunberg. Greta is a powerful voice for the climate movement and a beacon of hope for the next generation. She reminds me of the urgent need for action, not tomorrow, not in a year, but right now. That kind of urgency? It’s rare. And it's incredibly moving. From a lone voice outside her school to sparking a worldwide movement, Greta’s shown us it’s not about how big you are, but how big you dream and fight. Standing tall even when she stood alone, she’s still out there, pushing for real change. And you know what? Her spirit ignited a fire in me. **[Today, I’m inviting you to join me in showing your support for Greta Thunberg, amplifying her call to action for our planet. Greta helped me realize that it's not enough to just make personal lifestyle changes. We need structural shifts, and massive policy changes — and fast. Inspired by her Friday strikes, I knew I had to do more. So, back in 2019, I took my activism to the front lines, right to the steps of the White House, every Friday. I was ready to be arrested, ready to make a statement.

We have an exciting update, team.
Earlier this month, we told you about Michael’s work to appoint judges to Colorado’s federal court. In the last three years, Michael has prioritized finding diverse, qualified candidates to recommend for Colorado’s federal court — and he has been incredibly successful in getting them nominated and confirmed by the Senate.
As of yesterday, the Senate has officially confirmed 200 judges since Biden took office. Not only is this more than Trump or Obama at this point in their terms, but it’s also the most diverse slate of judicial nominees under any president.
These judges will make critical decisions about our fundamental rights, the rule of law, and our democracy.
Our country will be stronger for having federal benches that look like us — and Michael’s work for Colorado was a vital piece of this progress.
With your support, Michael can continue building a more just, equal country. Will you help him protect our Senate majority this November by chipping in now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_052324_JudicialNoms_b_act]
Thank you for your support.
Team Bennet
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Team Bennet <info@michaelbennet.com>
Date: Mon, May 13, 2024 at 2:06 PM
Subject: Judges matter.
Friend,
Justice delayed is justice denied.
When judicial vacancies are left open on Colorado's federal court, sitting judges are forced to take on a large number of cases, and defendants are left waiting for a free and fair trial.
In the last three years, Michael has worked hard to address this issue by filling open seats on Colorado's federal bench with highly qualified, diverse judges.
Because of Michael’s work with Senator John Hickenlooper, President Biden has appointed five highly qualified, diverse judges to the seven-judge bench — and Colorado is no longer in a “judicial emergency.”
You can read more about his work on judicial nominees here >> [https://gazette.com/colorado_politics/bennet-hickenlooper-court-how-2-senators-left-their-mark-on-court/article_a94d8002-1e4d-515e-9470-b766fdbde131.html]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_052324_JudicialNoms_b_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_052324_JudicialNoms_b_act]
With these nominations, Michael made it a point to find the best candidates with diverse experiences and backgrounds.
He's worked to put more women and people of color on Colorado's federal bench and to recommend nominees from all parts of Colorado with experience in different areas of the law.
For the first time, Colorado will have a district judge based outside of Denver. Judge Gordon P. Gallagher, from the Western Slope, will be stationed in Grand Junction. Upon her confirmation, Judge Charlotte Sweeney became the first openly LGBT woman to serve as a federal judge west of the Mississippi River. And Judge Kato Crews is the only active African American judge on Colorado's District Court.
Thanks to Michael’s hard work, Colorado has become one of the most effective states at filling judicial vacancies. Your grassroots support helps Michael continue to make progress for Colorado. Whether it’s $5, $10, or $50, will you chip in to support his campaign now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_052324_JudicialNoms_b_act]

clean_body: If we’re going to build the kind of multiracial working-class movement we need to win more victories for our communities, it starts with states like Arizona — and crucial open seats like this. | | | We have a polling update for you from the open seat race in Arizona's 3rd Congressional District, Peter — WFP-endorsed Raquel Terán is leading her closest opponent by 10 points in the latest poll from Progress Arizona! 1 Raquel is a longtime champion for working families in her community and across Arizona — and when voters hear her platform of economic, racial, and abortion justice, they support her. But while 30% of the district’s likely voters say they plan to cast their ballot for Raquel in this poll, another 37% are still undecided ahead of the July primary. If we’re going to build the kind of multiracial working-class movement we need to win more victories for our communities, it starts with states like Arizona — and crucial open seats like this. Raquel understands that we need to both block the MAGA Republicans fighting for power and build working class governing power in our communities. In her career, she's blocked the power-hungry right wing by organizing against Arizona’s infamous “show me your papers” racial profiling law, leading a successful recall for the legislator responsible, and helping defeat Sheriff Joe Arpaio.2 And she's built power for working people by fighting as a state legislator for higher wages, affordable health care, better public schools, and access to safe and legal abortions. Raquel is an organizer with vision and values, and she’s exactly the kind of champion we need in Congress. But campaigns like Raquel’s can’t rely on big money donors — she’s counting on all of us for the resources to make sure voters have the information they need before they head to the polls in July. Did you see this?

**The _Cincinnati Enquirer_ just highlighted how productive Greg has been in his first term in Congress:** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85506289/474986070/-417552776?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.05.23_b1_tghq_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNkNmY0Zi0zYjE5LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DoWNqWpUzUl-MXI-wKqD71QnAXNqXNi9yUgoLyUtyCo=) Team, we’re so proud to have Greg representing Southwest Ohio in Congress.

He’s stood up for reproductive rights. He’s defended our democracy. And he’s secured bipartisan progress on foreign aid and national security.

But not every member of Congress can say the same thing.

Many Republicans in Washington are more interested in playing political games and securing their next Fox News appearance than they are in getting things done.

Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponents – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of defeating her and winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical House seat and replace Lauren Boebert in Congress? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. But I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85507120/474988987/1610638071?refcode=em20240523am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=2cb6edc6-3c19-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2I2ZWRjNi0zYzE5LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZA3l13ASm1RlWINkj0bfT2XMJiCzCdUgpVfm7KMGNGc=)

These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties.

You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course.

**The first step is ...EDUCATION.**

Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.

That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty.

Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.**

We hear a lot about the "Free State of Florida," or all the people and businesses moving to Texas. But what about those of us who love our state, but our state doesn't seem to love us back? I live in California, raise my family in California, and love California, but California has leaders who, during the pandemic, shuttered the state's churches, but let the bars, liquor stores, and strip clubs stay open. It's quite a situation to be in, and I'm not alone. For this week's Hold the Line podcast, I share a message I delivered to Pursuit Church in Seattle, Washington. Like California, Washington State deals with incompetent, left-wing leaders who are focused on all the wrong things and keep destroying beautiful states full of wonderful people. The sermon and this podcast are appropriately titled, "The Prescription for JOY for Those Living in a Blue State." I hope you'll give it a listen and share it with a friend or family member living in a blue state! _**🎧LISTEN ON ITUNES⬇︎⬇︎⬇︎**_

name: Sarah McBride
subject: The most important gun safety bill that we've passed during my time in the legislature was signed into law
body:
We’ve proven Delaware can do big things.
#
**The most important gun safety bill that we’ve passed during my time as State Senator was recently signed into law.**
The law, which requires a permit to purchase a handgun, will do more than any other to curb the kind of gun violence we most frequently see in Delaware.
It will keep our guns off our streets.
It will help prevent suicides.
**It will save lives.**
**Everyone deserves to feel safe in their community.** That’s why I’m proud to have voted for meaningful, common-sense gun safety policies like this one — and I’m ready to take this fight to Congress. ****[**Will you pitch in $5 to help me get there?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240523-1?refcode=em20240523-1-477&amount=5&refcode2=477_21716_Q7TlKh&akid=477%2E21716%2EQ7TlKh)****
The truth is, when it comes to guns, our country has lost its common sense.
**We need leaders in Congress to step up and fight for the safety of our loved ones and children.**
**We need leaders in Congress to pass common-sense gun safety laws** — like banning assault weapons, instituting safeguards to prevent dangerous individuals from getting guns, and strengthening background checks.
Fewer policies are more urgent and high stakes. That’s why in the State Senate, I’ve stood up to the NRA, rolled up my sleeves, and passed historic gun safety reform like my legislation banning guns in our schools.
**Now, I’m running for Congress to continue to deliver real results on gun safety, but I need your help to get there.**
**[**Can you pitch in $5 to support my campaign to become Delaware’s next member of Congress?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240523-1?refcode=em20240523-1-477&amount=5&refcode2=477_21716_Q7TlKh&akid=477%2E21716%2EQ7TlKh)**

Together, we’ve proven that Delaware can do big things and pass life-saving gun safety policies. With your help, we’ll get it done in Washington.
Thank you!
Sarah McBride

| | The Great Depression left millions of Americans struggling — especially seniors who had lost their savings and were unable to work. In 1935, President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed the Social Security Bill into law as part of the New Deal to provide a safety net for those facing financial insecurity. **The program has since become one of the most enduring and important government programs in history, providing critical support to millions of Americans through:**
* **Reliable income:** providing financial assistance to retired workers through regular payments, ensuring a basic level of income in their later years.
* **Retirement protection:** Almost all workers in the United States participate in Social Security through payroll tax contributions. Seniors have spent a lifetime contributing to Social Security, and they are entitled to the benefits they have earned.
* **Uplifting vulnerable populations:** Social Security lifts above the poverty line both vulnerable seniors and children, who would otherwise lack critical access to an economic safety net. Additionally, Social Security is particularly important for people of color as they face racial disparities connected both to work and health.

Data from AARP shows that nearly one in five Washingtonians — 1.4 million people — receive Social Security benefits, and 36% of residents 65 and older rely on the program for at least half of their income. Most of these folks have been paying into Social Security and using the benefits for decades.**** **But Social Security is under attack.** At the end of March, my Republican colleagues released their desired budget for 2025 and I am disheartened to see that they continue to push for more cuts to essential programs including Social Security. **This is a prime example of what is at stake in November.**[**Will you chip in $14 to my campaign and help ensure Democrats reclaim the House?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85508771/474994528/1596212816?refcode=2024-05-23-socialsecurity&recurring=&amount=14&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=381ebb29-4119-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODFlYmIyOS00MTE5LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MwHBovBrKrf8M9mvMa0mdAPRNuKjygUJGSgVOF44dGg=) MAGA extremists are willing to ignore and undermine the needs of their own constituents. **They are eager to strip away vital programs like Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid just to propel their own agendas — and we simply cannot allow that to happen.** As a long-time advocate for Social Security, I will continue to defend this program and others that help ensure a dignified life for all regardless of socioeconomic status. "CHINA'S SILENT WAR ON AMERICA"
A SERIES OF 10 WEEKLY "LESSONS"**

---
|
**Dear Friend,**

Thank you for reading this one-time message about how America is being infiltrated by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP).

Below is the Introduction to an Ohio-developed, 10-week "course" titled, “China’s Silent War on America”, as well as Lesson 1: “China is Undermining American National Security”.

We'll be including links to these lessons in our regular (most of the time!) Sunday emails. This is the only time you'll get a message like this from us, on this topic, so please don't worry about us spamming you!

This is brought to us by [**Keep America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=03446e383d&e=5c740fa3e2). **THANK YOU!

~ Mark**

* * *
**Introduction & Lesson 1 of a 10-Week Course:
"China is Undermining American National Security**" **Introduction** Recently grassroots leaders in Ohio became acutely aware of the many national security threats posed by Communist China as Communist China attempts to embed itself into every aspect of America’s economy, politics, society (including our schools) and sovereignty. China’s major goal is to establish itself as the dominant force on the globe thereby establishing a new world order. This will require the takeover of the United States. Communist China is currently waging war with America; a war they plan on winning. It is a war where the weapons do not have physical bullets but it’s a war nonetheless. If America is to survive this war we must first arm ourselves with knowledge so we may mobilize our forces to push back against this silent invasion. We must never forget America was founded on freedom and that Communist China was founded on the suppression of freedom. These two ideologies cannot co-exist. We have an important decision to make or it will be made for us by Communist China. That said, America for Americans will provide a short lesson each of the next ten weeks to educate the reader on the many strategies China is using to undermine America’s power at home and abroad, while enriching its own homeland. The reader will also be guided towards action items to help reduce China’s influence in the state of Ohio. **Lesson 1: China’s undermining of America’s National Security**
China is currently undermining America’s national security. It is important for the reader understand national security is a broad term and frankly, has many definitions. For purposes of this series of lessons we will define National Security**** as all the actions a country takes [_to protect itself_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=5a00c5e74f&e=5c740fa3e2) from its enemies. This includes not only the military, but also the protection of the country's [_values and beliefs_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=61a23af812&e=5c740fa3e2). National security is the way a country keeps itself safe from harm and maintains its sovereignty and beliefs. For a country to have a strong national security it must not just be strong and united in its values and beliefs within its borders, it must also have [_strategic alliances_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=a20eb2676e&e=5c740fa3e2) with other like-minded countries outside of its borders and have a strong military to support these alliances. If a country is lacking in either category it is vulnerable to its enemies. America is vulnerable and China is intentionally contributing to these vulnerabilities both inside of America and abroad. China knows it must [_weaken America_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=af36396dc2&e=5c740fa3e2) if it is to become the dominant global power. Please watch this excellent 9-minute video for a general overview of just how serious the threat of China is within the borders of America: _[Video: China: “The Defining Threat of our Generation”](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=9e1311a7eb&e=5c740fa3e2)_ This video seemed to list all the ways China could possibly be influencing America: that is not quite all the ways as the following article will show. Read this 3-minute article to see how Communist China has also embedded itself into many of our federal agencies, leaving Americans at the mercy of Communist China’s many nefarious schemes. _[Article: House GOP Launches Government-Wide Probe Into Federal Response to CCP Political Warfare](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=6a44ad0525&e=5c740fa3e2)_
_**Next Lesson, Lesson 2: China’s Goal of World Domination Using the Belt and Road Initiative.**_

**PLEASE TAKE ACTION!**

After reading Lesson 1 in the China’s Silent War on America lesson series, you now have more knowledge. Sadly, knowledge is not power-unless it is put to use. Below are two ways to make this lesson more powerful.
1. Sign up to receive lessons by [_CLICKING HERE_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=058a58a0b0&e=5c740fa3e2) if this message was forwarded to you from a friend. Input your email address, name, county and state. Your information will NOT be shared with anyone but will guarantee that you receive future lessons and updates on this critical topic after the lesson series is complete.
2. Share this lesson on social media. [_CLICK HERE_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=351d3d1f50&e=5c740fa3e2) to share on the Facebook. [_CLICK HERE_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=476c76d800&e=5c740fa3e2) to share on X (formerly know as Twitter).
3. Share this lesson via text or email. Simply [_copy this link_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=5c1ef95b23&e=5c740fa3e2) then paste it into a text or email message to at least three friends.

_We hope you enjoyed the first lesson. In a few weeks we will start to include information about the influence the Communist China has in Ohio._ _From your friends at Keep America for Americans_

#
Mark your calendars, Peter: Donald Trump and Joe Biden are set to debate on June 27.
Four years ago, Donald Trump lost two debates to Joe Biden. Like the sore loser that he is, he hasn’t shown up to one since.

It's happened again, Peter: Powerful and corrupt men have taken over the headlines.

I'm far from shocked. Ever since I took my oath as attorney general and swore to do everything in my power to finally bring the most corrupt actors to justice, they have not stopped trying to take me down.

**But here’s the thing: It doesn’t matter which office they once held or how much money they have behind them, I will never be silenced. I will put my head down and go to work for the great people of New York, without fear, without favor, every day.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85510828/475000771/-2022193277?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1458-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NjgyMmEwYi00NjE5LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QheV0vH92vrcbO5V7LszwUGoYmwOUdpgJ43ypzLGCoA=)
In the five years I’ve been in office, I’ve stayed true to my mission of holding the shady forces who have ruled our nation for generations accountable. I knew that standing up to these people and groups was going to earn me enemies. I knew that after decades of elected officials turning a blind eye, my mission would put a target on my back. But I also knew that New York’s working families deserved a champion – and I would do it all a thousand times over.

But I’m nowhere near done fighting for the voiceless and vulnerable, _especially_ now that these powerful and corrupt actors have shown their true colors. | Peter,

I came across an interesting statistic a few days back.

_**Less than 7% of congressional members are moms with minor children.**_

This is, unfortunately, probably not a surprising statistic. Running for Congress is already hard enough without having to worry about money, time away from your kids, and childcare.

Now, add gender and age to the equation. If I had a dollar each time someone noted those factors or my having kids as a concern for holding office, I’d have enough money to beat Jack Bergman in November.

These disparities are why we end up with more men in Congress preventing investments in childcare access, gutting women’s healthcare, and neglecting families in rural communities like ours.

I know we can win in November, but we need a concerted grassroots effort to get us there. **Polling shows Jack Bergman’s extreme views are out of step with Upper and Northern Michiganders. Strong fundraising is how we send him packing.**

[_**I’m counting on you, Peter. clean_body: Less than 7% of congressional members are moms with minor children. | = | Peter, I came across an interesting statistic a few days back. Less than 7% of congressional members are moms with minor children. This is, unfortunately, probably not a surprising statistic. Running for Congress is already hard enough without having to worry about money, time away from your kids, and childcare. Now, add gender and age to the equation. If I had a dollar each time someone noted those factors or my having kids as a concern for holding office, I’d have enough money to beat Jack Bergman in November. These disparities are why we end up with more men in Congress preventing investments in childcare access, gutting women’s healthcare, and neglecting families in rural communities like ours. I know we can win in November, but we need a concerted grassroots effort to get us there. Polling shows Jack Bergman’s extreme views are out of step with Upper and Northern Michiganders. CONTACT: Houston Keene

Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom Files to Unseat Mary Peltola in Congress

ANCHORAGE, AK - Today, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom officially filed
her paperwork with the Alaska Division of Elections to unseat Mary
Peltola and bring real Alaskan leadership back to Congress.

<https://dfx1kn0n80mx5.cloudfront.net/email/image/e6a5ab705f6c4f36a2a1c3
464aa751cd.JPG>

Crime, inflation, and illegal immigration are all on the rise in Alaska
and across America. The negative impact of these and more under Joe
Biden and Mary Peltola are compounded as we lose energy independence,
watch our national security crumble, and struggle as our dollar doesn't
go as far.

Lt. Governor Dahlstrom released the following statement after filing to
run for Congress, noting that it's time for a real leader in
Washington, one who will fight for our priorities as Alaskans, not
political agendas.

"Today, I officially filed to run for Congress because it's time we
return tough, proven, conservative leadership to Alaska. Mary Peltola
has proven she does not have our great state's interests at heart -
whether it is her reckless energy agenda that is crushing our economy,
her anti-military votes, or her open border record," Lt. Governor Nancy
Dahlstrom said in a statement. "Alaskans are tired of Peltola's failed
leadership, and I am the best candidate to ensure we have a real
conservative leader representing us in Congress."

Dahlstrom's filing comes after a busy week where she toured the
Southern border and then spent time in Fairbanks meeting with voters.

**** Peter –

May is Mental Health Awareness Month, so I’d like to talk to you about the disease of addiction and substance use disorder – a disease that’s affected so many American families, including my own.

For years my son struggled with substance use and addiction.

As a parent, it’s beyond terrifying to watch as the disease gradually takes over your child’s life. Sapping him of his gifts. _How did the little boy so filled with life grow into the glazed-over, disinterested teen? Where is my 21-year-old at this hour – and with whom?_

And yet despite the sleepless nights, and the endless questioning, my son was able to get the help he needed – and our family has found that there’s real hope and joy in recovery. Harry is now an advocate for those struggling with substance use disorder – working at the same organization where he first sought recovery.

It’s past time that we end the stigma of addiction – and for Congress to take action to provide resources to individuals and families dealing with substance use disorder.

I’m prioritizing solutions that will help others find the hope in recovery. That’s why I’ve introduced legislation aimed at getting all who are suffering from substance use disorder the help they deserve. This includes expanding funding and resources for those experiencing homelessness, providing more robust mental health services, lowering costs for treatment options, and helping young people gain early access to therapy.

Peter:

My name is Janelle Bynum. I’m a State Representative, small business owner, mother of four, and **the official Democratic nominee running to unseat extreme Republican Rep. Lori Chavez-Deremer in Oregon’s 5th Congressional District.**

Democrats need to flip four seats from red-to-blue this November to take back the House – and this is one of them.

[**More in a moment, but it’s essential that we start the general election off on the strongest note possible to flip this seat and take back the House. Will you split a donation between The Collective PAC and my campaign today?** ](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqskv9NQB2VWDB7dxl6GOAMoQgQ07sUsGysQsq90BXY2LFFHILFUkWUVNFO8yDf-a6ABcvNhTv4qfE4ZIoPboNM3cp9eIJDxdnsZRe-44klCZOl73kz-yODWFONJdZ7X_063EcGrG3Drkz6s55wZGmFpuJEyjdRhTyLZsAI7Ei_YhDIVsIwDtZ4ANyw6su6MWXE7fbBEeWyODuk3CL3CcbwQe__W2Ilj8lgwwC-9ZYfslyVlpt4FYXHMgEki1oLEheV3bP1gKVQSXmn0f6Z3XsqyHV835D92ufwYL3tN0e9Q_e6IW0PZplcw_MMMNKqzuARN56OGr3voTnjdkg4IC3EJ9P-6OyOaPT4Lnce9B1p70KlmPqqjzmCXDeT9aBEgj2k/46l/B9b28KaARXy-f3ERZOT0tA/h2/h001.v3VjPGNrsfWrLOGYRizQlNnNPfGA1a9_4c3gnv2rvyQ)

The road to this moment wasn’t easy, and there won't be anything simple about defeating Lori Chavez-DeRemer in November. **But I am determined to meet this moment, to win, and to fight for families like yours and mine in Congress.**

I learned from my parents that you don’t stop working hard until the hard job is done, especially when it comes to fighting for your community.

I'm ready to get to work and win this thing because the stakes of this election are too high not to. Reproductive freedom, voting rights, affordable health care, our democracy itself – it’s all on the line this November.

**Simply put: Oregonians can’t afford another two years of Lori Chavez-DeRemer and the extreme MAGA Republican House Majority.**

[**Our real fight starts now, Peter. So I'm personally asking: Will you split $10 between me and The Collective PAC to make sure we have the resources we need to flip this seat, take back the House majority, and get the job done in November?** ](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqskv9NQB2VWDB7dxl6GOAMoQgQ07sUsGysQsq90BXY2LFFHILFUkWUVNFO8yDf-a6ABcvNhTv4qfE4ZIoPboNM3cp9eIJDxdnsZRe-44klCZOl73kz-yODWFONJdZ7X_063EcGrG3Drkz6s55wZGmFpN78pcDqyXjfWXAbJf8NzeZqS0oBozLZFEEOolVryh6f2qYFw6qOzLrvmjMiJ2Igcw1torhC1sb89bWsmVGab3xA56iBmNgFYrZ1fQlUQ7Zv4fQopINfw66u3snpHNRTya3_8VDJ1FsZwY8MKq-3vC3aJ3TwfzMhkSHJlcQW_j-dVabDAvNFi_yhgv_sH6bc_GSTpKIxy2Nys1RuY-9X5GwlhNRHFhnmlLZDkvt4uULE/46l/B9b28KaARXy-f3ERZOT0tA/h3/h001.gd7c2v-E-srt7LetpJ4AcyNs4l5j2KHD1RgtVkgI5nE)

Janelle Bynum

name: Josh Harder
subject: Yikes…
body:
Not good.

Peter,
There’s major news in our campaign, and I want you to hear this from me: One of the GOP’s biggest Super PACs just reserved $1.6 million in TV reservations in our media market this fall.
I’m incredibly frustrated because every time they launch new ads against me, our team has to increase our goals and figure out how we’re going to respond.
This is the biggest ad reservation that we’ve ever faced this early in an election. But the good news is that the GOP showed its hand early - and now we need to prepare an effective response. We have to get our ads filmed and make our TV reservations before all the ad time is sold out.
